Off the Rails#001.src: Tch... Another filthy poor... No, I won't give you any money.
Off the Rails#001.dst: 嘖……又一個髒兮兮的窮鬼……不行，我不會給你錢。
Off the Rails#001.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#002.src: I don't care if you're struggling to get by. In this world, you've gotta put in some work to make it through.
Off the Rails#002.dst: 你日子過不下去不關我的事。在這個世界上，想活下去就得付出勞動。
Off the Rails#002.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#003.src: Besides, I've talked to enough of you hobos for one day. I'll be glad to take the Subway out of here.
Off the Rails#003.dst: 何況我今天跟你們這種流浪漢講的話已經夠多了。能搭地鐵離開這裡我求之不得。
Off the Rails#003.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#004.src: ...Heh... That look on your face... You don't know about the Subway?
Off the Rails#004.dst: ……呵……你那個表情……你不知道地鐵是什麼？
Off the Rails#004.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#005.src: Wow, I thought taking a ride on that thing was the dream of every peasant around here, what with the way my proles are always going on about it.
Off the Rails#005.dst: 哇，我還以為搭那玩意兒一趟是這一帶每個賤民的夢想呢，畢竟我那些下人成天把它掛在嘴上。
Off the Rails#005.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#006.src: Well, it's an underground transport system that goes all over the province... Not that that matters for a beggar like you, of course. You'll never be able to afford a trip! Ha!
Off the Rails#006.dst: 好吧，那是一套通到全行省的地下運輸系統……當然，這跟你這種乞丐沒什麼關係。你這輩子都買不起一張票的！哈！
Off the Rails#006.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#007.src: Now, if you'll excuse me, my train to Auburn arrives in a few minutes. I have important business there. Nothing for you to worry about. Toodles!
Off the Rails#007.dst: 那麼，恕我失陪，我去 Auburn 的列車再幾分鐘就到了。我在那裡有要緊的生意。不干你的事。再會啦！
Off the Rails#007.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#008.src: Turn in your subway pass at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Off the Rails#009.src: Hey! What are you doing? The rails aren't safe! If you want to get to the other side, take the overpass!
Off the Rails#009.dst: 喂！你在幹什麼？鐵軌很危險！要到對面去請走天橋！
Off the Rails#009.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#010.src: Sigh... Welcome to the {p} subway station. Got a ticket?
Off the Rails#010.dst: 唉……歡迎來到 {p} 地鐵站。有票嗎？
Off the Rails#010.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#011.src: Alright... I'll stamp your hand to mark that you're allowed on the train. Give me a moment.
Off the Rails#011.dst: 好……我在你手上蓋個章，標明你可以上車。等我一下。
Off the Rails#011.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#012.src: There. You should be good to go now.
Off the Rails#012.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#013.src: The train gets here in about fifteen minutes. Happy travels...
Off the Rails#013.dst: 列車大約十五分鐘後到。旅途愉快……
Off the Rails#013.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#014.src: Wait for the train to arrive.

Off the Rails#017.src: Eheh... I must have had you all wrong. Let's, er, put aside our past grievances.
Off the Rails#017.dst: 欸嘿……看來我完全誤會你了。我們，呃，就把先前的不愉快放下吧。
Off the Rails#017.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#018.src: Say, buddy, could you do your friend a favor? I've got a meeting in Auburn soon, I need to get on this train.
Off the Rails#018.dst: 這樣吧，老兄，能不能幫你朋友一個忙？我在 Auburn 有場會議，我一定得上這班車。
Off the Rails#018.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#019.src: What do you say you... Give me your space? Just tell the clerk over there that you'll sacrifice your spot for me.
Off the Rails#019.dst: 你要不要……把你的位子讓給我？你只要跟那邊的站員說你願意把位子讓給我就行了。
Off the Rails#019.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#023.src: (By the Queen... Must I really say this to every customer?)
Off the Rails#023.dst: (女王在上……我真的每一個客人都得講一遍嗎？)
Off the Rails#023.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#024.src: Oh, hey, stranger. Looking for a chat? Sure, it'll help kill some time, I guess.
Off the Rails#024.dst: 噢，嘿，陌生人。想聊聊？好啊，反正也能打發時間。

Off the Rails#025.src: The name's Malic, nice to meet you. I'm guessing you'll be taking the train to the same place as me? To {p}?
Off the Rails#025.dst: 我叫 Malic，幸會。我猜你跟我要去同一個地方吧？去 {p}？
Off the Rails#025.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#026.src: I'm pretty excited about it. Around these parts, people never really get the opportunity to travel the Queen's Line. Too expensive for us, typically.
Off the Rails#026.dst: 我還蠻興奮的。在這一帶，人們幾乎沒有機會搭女王線。對我們來說通常太貴了。
Off the Rails#026.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#027.src: It's always been a dream of mine to see what other parts of Fruma are like, though, so I... well, I saved up for a long time.
Off the Rails#027.dst: 不過，看看 Fruma 其他地方長什麼樣子一直是我的夢想，所以我……嗯，存了很久的錢。
Off the Rails#027.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#028.src: Don't really know what the {p}'ll be like... I can't wait to find out. If it's anything like its Sovereign, it should be pretty great.
Off the Rails#028.dst: 我不太清楚 {p} 會是什麼樣子……真等不及要見識了。如果它跟它的統領有幾分像，那應該很不錯。
Off the Rails#028.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#029.src: Heh. Enough yammering from me, though. You probably have your own stuff you wanna talk about, right? (After Malic's introduction)
Off the Rails#029.dst: 呵。我話太多了。你大概也有自己想聊的事吧？(Malic 自我介紹之後)
Off the Rails#029.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#030.src: Anything else you wanna talk about? (When the dialogue options reappear)
Off the Rails#030.dst: 還有別的想聊的嗎？(對話選項再次出現時)
Off the Rails#030.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#031.src: Hey again! Anything to say? (Subsequent conversations with Malic)
Off the Rails#031.dst: 又見面啦！有話想說嗎？(後續與 Malic 的對話)
Off the Rails#031.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#032.src: Enough of this, though, or I'll get too excited. Anything else you wanna talk about? (After asking about the {p})
Off the Rails#032.dst: 先講到這裡，不然我會太興奮。還有別的想聊的嗎？(問過 {p} 之後)
Off the Rails#032.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#033.src: Sigh. Anything else you wanna talk about? (After asking about Soda)
Off the Rails#033.dst: 唉。還有別的想聊的嗎？(問過 Soda 之後)
Off the Rails#033.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#034.src: Oh, shoot. The train's here. I'll catch you later, I guess?
Off the Rails#034.dst: 噢，糟了。車來了。那我們待會兒見？
Off the Rails#034.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#035.src: ...Wow... Fascinating... I wonder what the cat symbolizes...
Off the Rails#035.dst: ……哇……真有意思……不知道那隻貓象徵什麼……

Off the Rails#036.src: Oh, hi! Are you from around here? My name's Maddison, I'm a tourist from Aelumia.
Off the Rails#036.dst: 噢，嗨！你是這附近的人嗎？我叫 Maddison，是從 Aelumia 來的觀光客。
Off the Rails#036.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#037.src: I've been travelling the Queen's Line all around Fruma to see what the rest of the province is like! It's been a fun time so far! ...Well, mostly...
Off the Rails#037.dst: 我一直在搭女王線環遊 Fruma，想看看行省其他地方長什麼樣子！到目前為止都很好玩！……嗯，大部分啦……
Off the Rails#037.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#038.src: This region has been... It's not quite what I expected. There's quite a unique culture here, though! Check out the cool wall art! You never see that back home!
Off the Rails#038.dst: 這個地區……跟我想的不太一樣。不過這裡的文化很獨特！你看那些牆上的畫多酷！在我家鄉根本看不到！
Off the Rails#038.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#039.src: I'm really looking forward to seeing what makes {p} different- that's where I'm headed next. So far, everywhere has been really unique!
Off the Rails#039.dst: 我很期待看看 {p} 有什麼不一樣——那是我下一站。到目前為止每個地方都很有特色！
Off the Rails#039.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#040.src: I'm just sad I'll miss their festival... The one here went... bad.
Off the Rails#040.dst: 只可惜我會錯過他們的慶典……這裡的那場……辦砸了。
Off the Rails#040.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#041.src: ...Anyway, is there anything you'd like to talk about? (After Maddison's introduction)
Off the Rails#041.dst: ……總之，有什麼你想聊的嗎？(Maddison 自我介紹之後)
Off the Rails#041.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#042.src: ...Anything else you'd like to discuss? (When the dialogue options reappear)
Off the Rails#042.dst: ……還有別的想討論的嗎？(對話選項再次出現時)
Off the Rails#042.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#043.src: Hi again! Want to talk? (Subsequent conversations with Maddison)
Off the Rails#043.dst: 又見面啦！想聊聊嗎？(後續與 Maddison 的對話)
Off the Rails#043.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#044.src: Oh, well... Anything else you'd like to discuss?(After asking about Maddison's trip)
Off the Rails#044.dst: 噢，這個嘛……還有別的想討論的嗎？(問過 Maddison 的旅程之後)
Off the Rails#044.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#045.src: Roughworks? Oh, right, that's what the people here call it. To me, it's the {p}.
Off the Rails#045.dst: Roughworks？噢對，這裡的人是這樣叫的。對我來說，那是 {p}。
Off the Rails#045.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#046.src: I always imagined this place being a bit... cleaner. Maybe the people here are just used to it being messy, though?
Off the Rails#046.dst: 我一直以為這個地方會……乾淨一點。不過也許這裡的人早就習慣它亂七八糟了？
Off the Rails#046.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#047.src: A lot of the people I tried talking to were, well, not very nice. They didn't seem to like tourists all that much...
Off the Rails#047.dst: 我試著搭話的人，很多都，嗯，不太友善。他們好像不怎麼喜歡觀光客……
Off the Rails#047.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#048.src: Overall, this... has probably been the low point of my trip. I think it's just not for me, really. But there were some parts I liked!
Off the Rails#048.dst: 整體來說，這……大概是我這趟旅程的低點。我想這裡真的不適合我。不過還是有些部分我喜歡！
Off the Rails#048.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#049.src: I already mentioned the pretty murals, but there was a bunch of other cool stuff, too. Did you know the people here fight to resolve disputes?
Off the Rails#049.dst: 那些漂亮的壁畫我剛提過了，不過還有很多其他很酷的東西。你知道這裡的人是用打架來解決紛爭的嗎？
Off the Rails#049.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#050.src: ...Or, wait. You would, since you're from here, right? Or... no, you're dressed pretty different. Where are you from?
Off the Rails#050.dst: ……噢，等等。你應該知道吧，你是這裡的人嘛？還是……不對，你的穿著很不一樣。你是哪裡人？
Off the Rails#050.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#052.src: {p}'s beautiful. I've lived there my whole life, it's my home, it's precious to me.
Off the Rails#052.dst: {p} 很美。我一輩子都住在那裡，那是我的家，對我很珍貴。
Off the Rails#052.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#053.src: It's just... When you've lived somewhere for that long, it starts to feel... small. Samey. Especially when you're boxed in by those towering city walls.
Off the Rails#053.dst: 只是……在一個地方住那麼久之後，它會開始讓人覺得……很小。都一個樣。尤其當你被那些高聳的城牆圍住的時候。
Off the Rails#053.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#054.src: Don't get me wrong, I'm proud to live in the Queen's royal city, but... I needed something new. A change of pace. That's why I decided to go on this trip!
Off the Rails#054.dst: 別誤會，能住在女王的王城我很驕傲，可是……我需要一點新東西。換個步調。所以我才決定出來旅行！
Off the Rails#054.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#055.src: I'm lucky enough to be the daughter of one of the University's best-paid professors, so I was able to afford such a privilege. Those tickets aren't cheap...
Off the Rails#055.dst: 我很幸運是大學裡薪水最高的教授之一的女兒，所以才負擔得起這種待遇。那些車票可不便宜……
Off the Rails#055.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#056.src: ...Anyway, sorry, that was a bit of a tangent. Overall, Aelumia's great if you enjoy the city life, it just... gets boring, eventually.
Off the Rails#056.dst: ……總之，抱歉，扯遠了。整體來說，如果你喜歡城市生活，Aelumia 很棒，只是……久了就會膩。
Off the Rails#056.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#057.src: So far, the trip's been pretty great! It's been really refreshing to see how different each region of Fruma is!
Off the Rails#057.dst: 到目前為止這趟旅程都很棒！看見 Fruma 每個地區有多麼不同，真的很讓人耳目一新！
Off the Rails#057.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#058.src: I've only been to the {p} and here, though. Both have been enlightening, in their own ways.
Off the Rails#058.dst: 不過我只去過 {p} 和這裡。兩個地方都各自很有啟發。
Off the Rails#058.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#059.src: The {p} may be the most beautiful place I've ever seen... Not that that's saying much. The landscapes were incredible, and oh, the flowers!
Off the Rails#059.dst: {p} 可能是我看過最美的地方……雖然這麼說也沒什麼份量啦。那裡的風景難以置信，還有，噢，那些花！
Off the Rails#059.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#060.src: This place? It's... I guess I've come to learn that some people live by different standards to me, which is... interesting.
Off the Rails#060.dst: 這裡？這……我想我學到了有些人依照跟我不同的標準在生活，這……很有意思。
Off the Rails#060.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#061.src: I'm a little sad the trip's coming to an end after the next stop... Fruma is so big, yet so small, isn't it?
Off the Rails#061.dst: 下一站之後這趟旅程就要結束了，我有點難過……Fruma 好大，又好小，對吧？
Off the Rails#061.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#062.src: I hear people used to live in the {p} and the Penitence District, but they were moved out. I wish I could go back in time and experience their culture, too.
Off the Rails#062.dst: 我聽說以前有人住在 {p} 和 Penitence District，但他們被遷走了。真希望我能回到過去，也體驗一下他們的文化。
Off the Rails#062.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#063.src: I think this might be the stop I'm most excited for!
Off the Rails#063.dst: 我想這一站可能是我最期待的！
Off the Rails#063.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#064.src: My dad teaches biology, and he's been all over the place studying the province's wildlife. His travels honestly inspired me to go on this journey.
Off the Rails#064.dst: 我爸爸教生物學，他為了研究行省的野生動物跑遍了各個地方。老實說，是他的旅程啟發我踏上這趟旅行的。
Off the Rails#064.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#065.src: Growing up, he told me stories of his trips... {p} was always the place that stood out the most, of the ones he described.
Off the Rails#065.dst: 我從小聽他講他旅途上的故事……他描述過的那些地方裡，{p} 一直是最突出的。
Off the Rails#065.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#066.src: It sounds like nothing you'd ever see anywhere else. Golden leaves, beautiful traditional architecture, and the kindest people...
Off the Rails#066.dst: 聽起來那是別的地方絕對看不到的景象。金色的葉子、美麗的傳統建築，還有最善良的人們……
Off the Rails#066.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#067.src: Needless to say, I've dreamed of going there my whole life. Of course, I also dreamed of going everywhere else, too. But Auburn most of all.
Off the Rails#067.dst: 不用說，我一輩子都夢想著去那裡。當然，其他地方我也都夢想著去啦。但最想去的還是 Auburn。
Off the Rails#067.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#068.src: Ah, them. I've not really spoken to either.
Off the Rails#068.dst: 啊，他們啊。我其實兩個都沒怎麼聊過。
Off the Rails#068.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#069.src: I tried talking to the one with the funny shirt, but they didn't seem much for conversation.
Off the Rails#069.dst: 我試著跟那個穿著怪衣服的人講話，但他好像不太想聊。
Off the Rails#069.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#070.src: The other guy? He seems to be from around here, and, well...
Off the Rails#070.dst: 另外那個人？他看起來是這一帶的人，然後，嗯……
Off the Rails#070.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#071.src: ...I don't have anything against the people of this District, but their attitudes differ from mine, and...
Off the Rails#071.dst: ……我對這個區的人沒有意見，可是他們的態度跟我不太一樣，而且……
Off the Rails#071.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#072.src: ...I'm just a little tired of being berated by them for coming here, okay?
Off the Rails#072.dst: ……我只是有點累了，一直因為來這裡而被他們罵，好嗎？
Off the Rails#072.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#073.src: Oh! The train's here! ...Uh, Guess I should catch you later?
Off the Rails#073.dst: 噢！車來了！……呃，那我們待會兒見？
Off the Rails#073.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#076.src: You want to talk? Sigh, fine. Fine, I guess.
Off the Rails#076.dst: 你想聊天？唉，好吧。好吧，隨便你。

Off the Rails#078.src: Ugh. Well, see, I'm from {p}. I... don't like it there. So I wanted to see what the {p} was like.
Off the Rails#078.dst: 唉。這樣吧，我是 {p} 來的。我……不喜歡那裡。所以我想看看 {p} 是什麼樣子。
Off the Rails#078.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#079.src: Having been here yourself, I'm sure you understand well how that turned out. Now, I'm heading home.
Off the Rails#079.dst: 你自己也來過這裡了，我相信你很清楚結果如何。現在，我要回家了。
Off the Rails#079.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#080.src: Really, at this point, I don't know if anywhere in this province is worth seeing. It must all be like this.
Off the Rails#080.dst: 老實說，到了這個地步，我不知道這個行省還有哪裡值得看。大概到處都是這樣。
Off the Rails#080.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#081.src: ...But enough about me. What do you want to say? (After Flinn's introduction)
Off the Rails#081.dst: ……不過我的事講夠了。你想說什麼？(Flinn 自我介紹之後)
Off the Rails#081.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#082.src: Anything else? (When the dialogue options reappear)
Off the Rails#082.dst: 還有別的事嗎？(對話選項再次出現時)
Off the Rails#082.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#083.dst: 幹嘛？(後續與 Flinn 的對話)
Off the Rails#083.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#084.src: Sorry about that, I got... Madder, than expected... Anything else you'd like to discuss? (After asking about the {p})
Off the Rails#084.dst: 抱歉，我剛剛……比預期的更火大……還有別的想討論的嗎？(問過 {p} 之後)
Off the Rails#084.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#085.src: I chose this place because it was the cheapest ticket... I had to exchange so many materials for those weird emeralds they use here.
Off the Rails#085.dst: 我選這個地方是因為票最便宜……我得換掉一大堆材料才能拿到他們這裡用的那種怪綠寶石。
Off the Rails#085.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#086.src: I had high expectations, thought seeing another part of the province might restore my hopes... It didn't.
Off the Rails#086.dst: 我本來期待很高，以為看看行省的另一個角落也許能重拾我的希望……結果沒有。
Off the Rails#086.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#087.src: I hoped, at least, that the Festival here would be cool, and instead, it was a complete disaster. On top of that, I missed the one back home...
Off the Rails#087.dst: 我至少希望這裡的慶典會很酷，結果它徹底是場災難。而且我還錯過了家鄉那一場……
Off the Rails#087.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#088.src: I'm just heading home. I guess I'll have to just... learn to like Auburn. Ugh...
Off the Rails#088.dst: 我要回家了。看來我只能……學著喜歡 Auburn 吧。唉……
Off the Rails#088.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#089.src: This shirt? Ugh... I forgot about this stupid shirt.
Off the Rails#089.dst: 這件衣服？唉……我都忘了這件蠢衣服。
Off the Rails#089.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#090.src: On the way here, some guy came up to me and begged on his knees for me to buy his shirt. It was hard to refuse... I felt bad...
Off the Rails#090.dst: 來的路上，有個人跑來跪著求我買下他的衣服。實在很難拒絕……我於心不忍……
Off the Rails#090.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#091.src: I guess "TC" stands for {p} City. For the record, I do NOT love {p} City.
Off the Rails#091.dst: 我猜「TC」是 {p} City 的意思吧。我要聲明，我一點也不愛 {p} City。
Off the Rails#091.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#092.src: In fact, this shirt doesn't even hold any value to me as a souvenier. I don't want to remember this trip.
Off the Rails#092.dst: 事實上，這件衣服連當紀念品的價值都沒有。我不想記得這趟旅程。
Off the Rails#092.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#093.src: I'm going to have to destroy it, or perhaps trade it for something. I never want to see it again.
Off the Rails#093.dst: 我得把它毀了，或者拿去換點別的。我再也不想看到它。
Off the Rails#093.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#095.src: It feels like we're living in squalor for no reason! You always hear these wonderful stories about other regions, like that the {p} have beautiful, huge lakes.
Off the Rails#095.dst: 感覺我們毫無理由地住在髒亂裡！你老是聽到別的地區有多美好的故事，像是 {p} 有又大又美的湖。
Off the Rails#095.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#096.src: If that's even true, why can't we get some of that water? Why must we put up with the pathetic trickle we get from the dam?
Off the Rails#096.dst: 如果那是真的，為什麼我們分不到一點那些水？為什麼我們得忍受水壩流下來的那可憐的一點點？
Off the Rails#096.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#097.src: And yet, everyone back home is just so... Okay??? With it??? They think the government couldn't wrong them. They build shrines to the Queen in their homes!
Off the Rails#097.dst: 然而，家鄉每個人卻都那麼……接受？？？他們覺得政府不可能虧待他們。他們在家裡替女王蓋神龕！
Off the Rails#097.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#098.src: It's just so... Frustrating!!! Why can't they see things the way I do??? The region itself is mostly fine, it's the people I can't stand!
Off the Rails#098.dst: 這實在太……令人抓狂了！！！為什麼他們就不能像我這樣看事情？？？地區本身大致上還可以，我受不了的是那裡的人！
Off the Rails#098.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#099.src: I don't even believe those stories anymore though... I think everywhere is just awful in its own way.
Off the Rails#099.dst: 不過我現在連那些故事都不信了……我覺得每個地方都以自己的方式爛透了。
Off the Rails#099.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#100.src: We were always sold this idea of the {p} as this beautiful place where proud workers labored for the Queen amidst beautiful crop fields... You've seen it, haven't you?
Off the Rails#100.dst: 他們一直把 {p} 賣給我們，說那是個美麗的地方，驕傲的工人在美麗的農田間為女王勞動……你看過了吧？
Off the Rails#100.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#101.src: I bet everywhere is just as bad. I just don't know what to think of anything anymore. It all feels like a lie. But maybe I'm just asking for too much, I don't know...
Off the Rails#101.dst: 我打賭每個地方都一樣糟。我已經不知道該怎麼看任何事了。一切都像是謊言。但也許只是我要求太多，我不知道……
Off the Rails#101.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#102.src: Other people? The girl tried talking to me, but she left me alone when she realized I didn't want to talk.
Off the Rails#102.dst: 其他人？那個女生有試著跟我講話，但她發現我不想聊之後就放過我了。
Off the Rails#102.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#103.src: And that other guy? I didn't notice him until just now.
Off the Rails#103.dst: 至於另外那個人？我到剛才才注意到他。
Off the Rails#103.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#104.src: ...Train's here. Stop talking to me, please...
Off the Rails#104.dst: ……車來了。拜託別再跟我說話了……
Off the Rails#104.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#105.src: Hey... Didn't I just ask you to not cause trouble? Could you stop that, please?
Off the Rails#105.dst: 喂……我剛剛不是才請你別惹麻煩嗎？可以停下來嗎，拜託？
Off the Rails#105.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#107.src: Listen. I don't feel like calling the guards over, okay? I'm asking you to please stop.
Off the Rails#107.dst: 聽著。我也不想把衛兵叫過來，好嗎？我是在請你停手。
Off the Rails#107.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#108.src: You're really annoying everyone here, including me. Thanks.
Off the Rails#108.dst: 你真的把這裡每個人都惹毛了，包括我。謝了。
Off the Rails#108.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#109.src: Sigh... Whatever, it's not like they're paying me enough to care...
Off the Rails#109.dst: 唉……算了，他們給我的薪水也不夠讓我在乎……
Off the Rails#109.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#111.src: Step aside, citizens. We're here on important business.
Off the Rails#111.dst: 請讓路，市民。我們有要事在身。

Off the Rails#112.src: The general of the Constables Division..? I wonder what's going on...
Off the Rails#112.dst: 警備部隊的將軍……？發生什麼事了……
Off the Rails#112.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#113.src: Keep your nose out of our matters, citizen. Our activities will have no impact on your trip.
Off the Rails#113.dst: 別多管我們的事，市民。我們的行動不會影響你們的旅程。

Off the Rails#115.src: Hey! What's the holdup? All aboard! Come on!
Off the Rails#115.dst: 喂！在磨蹭什麼？全體上車！快點！

Off the Rails#116.src: Hello passenger! I hope that the subway experience has been to your liking.
Off the Rails#116.dst: 您好，旅客！希望這趟地鐵之旅還合您的意。

Off the Rails#117.src: I am Telati, the attendant for your journey today. I am sorry I did not say hello when verifying your stamp, I was a little, uh, shocked by how many people were taking the train today.
Off the Rails#117.dst: 我是 Telati，今天這趟旅程的車勤員。抱歉我驗章的時候沒跟您打招呼，我有點，呃，被今天搭車的人數嚇到了。
Off the Rails#117.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#118.src: We don't get passengers often, to be honest with you, so to have even this many... That was a surprise. Not to mention General Levi being here, too.
Off the Rails#118.dst: 老實說我們平常很少有乘客，所以光是這個人數……就已經很意外了。更別說 Levi 將軍也在車上。
Off the Rails#118.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#119.src: Anyway, we should be arriving in {p} in an hour or two. Until then, feel free to talk with your fellow passengers, or take a nap.
Off the Rails#119.dst: 總之，我們大概一兩個小時後會抵達 {p}。在那之前，您可以跟其他旅客聊聊，或是小睡一下。
Off the Rails#119.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#120.src: I hope you have a good trip! And, if there's any issues, do not be afraid to speak with me.
Off the Rails#120.dst: 祝您旅途愉快！如果有任何問題，別客氣，儘管找我。
Off the Rails#120.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#121.src: Explore the train. Return to your seat at [-{~}, {~}, {~}] when done.
Off the Rails#121.dst: 在列車上四處看看。結束後回到 [-{~1}, {~2}, {~3}] 你的座位。

Off the Rails#122.src: Oh, hello there, passenger. Is something the matter?
Off the Rails#122.dst: 噢，您好，旅客。有什麼事嗎？
Off the Rails#122.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#123.src: ...You just want to chat? You know what, sure, it could be a nice break from my busywork.
Off the Rails#123.dst: ……您只是想聊聊？也好，這對我來說反而是從雜務裡喘口氣。
Off the Rails#123.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#124.src: As I told you before, my name's Telati. I'm... the only staffer on the train today. Besides the driver, Cusef, but he's busy, well, driving.
Off the Rails#124.dst: 我剛才說過了，我叫 Telati。我是……今天車上唯一的工作人員。除了司機 Cusef，不過他忙著，嗯，開車。
Off the Rails#124.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#125.src: That means I'm the only person here to attend our many passengers today. Again, we don't usually get this many.
Off the Rails#125.dst: 也就是說今天這麼多旅客，只有我一個人在服務。再說一次，我們平常不會有這麼多人。
Off the Rails#125.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#126.src: It's... It's okay though. Everyone seems fairly content. Besides that Cemor guy, at least.
Off the Rails#126.dst: 不過……不過還好啦。大家看起來都算滿意。至少除了那位 Cemor 先生之外。
Off the Rails#126.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#127.src: Enough about that though. What would you like to talk about? (After Telati's introduction)
Off the Rails#127.dst: 這個先不談了。您想聊些什麼？(Telati 自我介紹之後)
Off the Rails#127.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#128.src: ...Anything else to say? (When the dialogue options reappear)
Off the Rails#128.dst: ……還有別的話要說嗎？(對話選項再次出現時)
Off the Rails#128.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#129.src: Anything wrong? Or do you just want to chat? (Subsequent conversations with Telati)
Off the Rails#129.dst: 有什麼不對嗎？還是您只是想聊聊？(後續與 Telati 的對話)
Off the Rails#129.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#130.src: ...It's okay. I can handle it... Anything else to say? (After asking about the Other staff)
Off the Rails#130.dst: ……沒關係。我應付得來……還有別的話要說嗎？(問過其他工作人員之後)
Off the Rails#130.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#131.src: ...Whatever... Anything else to say? (After asking about Cemor)
Off the Rails#131.dst: ……算了……還有別的話要說嗎？(問過 Cemor 之後)
Off the Rails#131.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#132.src: ...Perhaps I shouldn't have let that slip... Uhm... Anything else to say...? (After asking about his Thoughts on the train)
Off the Rails#132.dst: ……也許我剛才不該說溜嘴的……呃……還有別的話要說嗎……？(問過他對這列車的想法之後)
Off the Rails#132.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#133.src: There aren't many of us, really. Each train usually has only {~} staffers- a driver and {~} attendants.
Off the Rails#133.dst: 我們其實人不多。每列車通常只有 {~} 名工作人員——一名司機和 {~} 名車勤員。
Off the Rails#133.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#134.src: The team for this particular train is Cusef the driver, plus Zathie and I.
Off the Rails#134.dst: 這一列的團隊是司機 Cusef，加上 Zathie 和我。
Off the Rails#134.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#135.src: This is typically enough, as the trains aren't very busy. Frankly, I don't know why they bother having this many carriages.
Off the Rails#135.dst: 這通常就夠了，因為列車並不忙。老實說，我不懂他們幹嘛要掛這麼多節車廂。
Off the Rails#135.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#136.src: It's usually only Aelumians and Highlanders who can afford trips, and, well... Most of those guys don't seem interested in seeing other regions.
Off the Rails#136.dst: 平常也只有 Aelumia 人和高地人負擔得起旅行，而，嗯……那些人大多對看看其他地區沒什麼興趣。
Off the Rails#136.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#137.src: This time of year is actually the exception, since the Festivals are on. But, having spoken to a few passengers, none seem to be travelling for that at all.
Off the Rails#137.dst: 一年之中這個時候其實是例外，因為各地慶典都在辦。不過我跟幾位旅客聊過，沒有一個是為了慶典來的。
Off the Rails#137.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#138.src: For today's trip to have so many people - and such a diverse set too - is an anomaly. It's unfortunate timing, too, since Zathie's on break.
Off the Rails#138.dst: 今天這趟能有這麼多人——而且組成這麼多元——是個異常。時機也不巧，因為 Zathie 剛好在休假。
Off the Rails#138.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#139.src: We were dealing with all the expected extra traffic from the Auburn Festival being on, and she burnt herself preparing a meal, so she got a couple days off.
Off the Rails#139.dst: 我們本來在應付 Auburn 慶典帶來的預期外的人潮，她準備餐點時燙傷了自己，所以放了幾天假。
Off the Rails#139.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#140.src: I thought it'd be fine since the Auburn Festival's wrapped up, but... I guess there's still a lot of interest in going there?
Off the Rails#140.dst: 我原以為 Auburn 慶典結束了應該就沒事了，結果……我想去那裡的人還是很多吧？
Off the Rails#140.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#141.src: Ah, my home. It may surprise you, but I'm from the Roughw- er- {p}.
Off the Rails#141.dst: 啊，我的家鄉。您可能會意外，我是 Roughw——呃——{p} 來的。
Off the Rails#141.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#142.src: I'm lucky to have a job such as this, living where I do. The conditions aboard the train are heavenly compared to where my neighbors work.
Off the Rails#142.dst: 以我住的地方來說，能有這樣一份工作算是幸運。列車上的環境跟我鄰居工作的地方比起來簡直是天堂。
Off the Rails#142.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#143.src: ...I do wonder why they can't share this quality of life. I suppose there must be a reason for it; I trust Her Majesty's judgement.
Off the Rails#143.dst: ……我確實會想，為什麼這種生活品質不能分享出去。我想一定有它的理由；我信任陛下的判斷。
Off the Rails#143.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#144.src: Ah, him. Yes, he's the Highlander sat in the dining carriage.
Off the Rails#144.dst: 啊，他啊。是的，就是坐在餐車裡那位高地人。
Off the Rails#144.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#145.src: He seems... needy. No- maybe that's just selfish of me to say.
Off the Rails#145.dst: 他看起來……很難伺候。不——也許這樣說是我自私。
Off the Rails#145.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#146.src: He keeps asking me to prepare him some specific meal, and... listen. The customer is always right, and all, but...
Off the Rails#146.dst: 他一直要我替他做某一道特定的餐點，然後……聽我說。顧客永遠是對的，這我懂，可是……
Off the Rails#146.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#147.src: I'm not the chef on this train. That's Zathie. I'm scared of messing up the recipe, and also just generally dislike cooking.
Off the Rails#147.dst: 我不是這列車上的廚師。廚師是 Zathie。我怕把食譜做壞，而且我本來就不喜歡下廚。
Off the Rails#147.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#148.src: So... I'm hanging out here as far away from him as possible, hoping he just... forgets about it.
Off the Rails#148.dst: 所以……我躲在這裡，離他愈遠愈好，希望他就這樣……忘了這件事。
Off the Rails#148.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#149.src: Sigh... Maybe that's immoral of me, I don't know.
Off the Rails#149.dst: 唉……也許這樣很不道德吧，我不知道。
Off the Rails#149.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#150.src: The train's like a second home to me. Maybe more of a home than my real home...
Off the Rails#150.dst: 這列車對我來說像第二個家。也許比我真正的家更像家……
Off the Rails#150.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#151.src: It's the most comfortable place I've ever been. I love it here.
Off the Rails#151.dst: 這是我待過最舒服的地方。我愛這裡。
Off the Rails#151.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#152.src: Getting to travel all over Fruma for free is such a privilege, too, I've seen some beautiful stations...
Off the Rails#152.dst: 能免費跑遍整個 Fruma 也是一種特權，我看過一些很美的車站……
Off the Rails#152.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#153.src: Yes, just stations. They never let me go beyond. But there's some gorgeous sights to see from there alone up in {p} or at {p}.
Off the Rails#153.dst: 是的，只有車站。他們從不讓我走出去。不過光是從 {p} 或 {p} 的站裡看出去，就有很壯麗的景色。
Off the Rails#153.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#154.src: ...I've only been to {p} a couple of times. It's military-only and they typically use their own trains to travel there...
Off the Rails#154.dst: ……{p} 我只去過幾次。那裡只對軍方開放，他們通常用自己的列車往返……
Off the Rails#154.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#155.src: ...But sometimes, there are urgent matters that require the use of civilian trains. Today seems to be one such instance of this.
Off the Rails#155.dst: ……不過有時候會有緊急事務需要動用民用列車。今天似乎就是這樣的情況。
Off the Rails#155.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#156.src: Oh! I'm so sorry! I must've forgotten to give you that.
Off the Rails#156.dst: 噢！非常抱歉！我一定是忘了給您那個。
Off the Rails#156.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#157.src: I- I was in such a hurry to accomodate everyone, it must have slipped my mind... I sincerely apologize.
Off the Rails#157.dst: 我、我當時忙著招呼所有人，一定是漏掉了……我誠心道歉。
Off the Rails#157.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#159.src: Oh, alright then. Have a good trip!
Off the Rails#159.dst: 噢，那好吧。祝您旅途愉快！
Off the Rails#159.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#160.src: I TOLD you, idiot, ya need to wear Aelumia purple! Since we're not assigned to the Roughworks anymore!
Off the Rails#160.dst: 我跟你「說」了，白痴，你得穿 Aelumia 紫！我們已經不歸 Roughworks 管了！

Off the Rails#161.src: Lighten up, Maury. At least I used the right colour for my sword's hilt.
Off the Rails#161.dst: 放輕鬆點，Maury。至少我劍柄的顏色用對了。

Off the Rails#162.src: NO, Harvin, that is NOT GOOD ENOUGH. We're already on thin ice after the sewage incident.
Off the Rails#162.dst: 不對，Harvin，那「還不夠」。污水那件事之後我們已經在薄冰上了。
Off the Rails#162.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#163.src: Bein' assigned to the General is a BIG DEAL! We can't screw it up, or we're OUT.
Off the Rails#163.dst: 被派給將軍是「天大的事」！我們搞砸就「完蛋」了。
Off the Rails#163.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#164.src: I still think the sewage incident was way overblown, but whatever.
Off the Rails#164.dst: 我到現在還是覺得污水那件事被過度渲染了，不過隨便啦。
Off the Rails#164.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#165.src: I agree, but that's not the p- Oh, hey there, citizen.
Off the Rails#165.dst: 我同意，可是重點不在那——噢，嘿，市民。
Off the Rails#165.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#166.src: Drop the act, Maury. They were there for like half the argument.
Off the Rails#166.dst: 別演了，Maury。他們差不多從我們吵到一半就在那裡了。
Off the Rails#166.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#167.src: WHAT? Why didn't ya tell me???
Off the Rails#167.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#169.src: Ech... Whatever. You. Whaddaya ya want. You wanna chat? Got a problem to report? What's goin' on. (After Harvin and Maury's introduction)
Off the Rails#169.dst: 咳……算了。你。你想幹嘛。想聊天？有問題要報案？怎樣。(Harvin 和 Maury 自我介紹之後)
Off the Rails#169.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#170.src: Got anythin' else you wanna say? (When the dialogue options reappear)
Off the Rails#170.dst: 還有別的想說的嗎？(對話選項再次出現時)
Off the Rails#170.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#171.src: Ugh, what is it now? (Subsequent conversations with Harvin and Maury)
Off the Rails#171.dst: 唉，這次又怎樣？(後續與 Harvin 和 Maury 的對話)
Off the Rails#171.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#172.src: ...We're movin' on before he says any more. Ask about somethin' else. (After asking about Whats going on)
Off the Rails#172.dst: ……在他再多說之前我們換個話題。問點別的。(問過「發生什麼事」之後)
Off the Rails#172.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#173.src: Me too, bud, me too... Ah, right. You. Anythin' else to say? (After asking about Any stories)
Off the Rails#173.dst: 我也是，老兄，我也是……啊，對了。你。還有別的想說的嗎？(問過「有什麼故事」之後)
Off the Rails#173.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#174.src: Talk about somethin' else instead. (After asking about the Sewage incident)
Off the Rails#174.dst: 換個別的講。(問過污水事件之後)
Off the Rails#174.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#175.src: That ain't fer your ears, kid.
Off the Rails#175.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#176.src: We're guarding General Levi on her trip to {p}, where she'll be helping investigate some kind of bre-
Off the Rails#176.dst: 我們在護送 Levi 將軍去 {p}，她要去協助調查某種破——
Off the Rails#176.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#177.src: HARVIN, NO. She told us NOT to tell anyone what's goin' on. And this door's thin, what if she hears us?
Off the Rails#177.dst: Harvin，不行。她「交代」我們別跟任何人講。而且這門很薄，萬一她聽到怎麼辦？
Off the Rails#177.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#179.src: I do wonder what happened though. She said it's really bad there, ton of soldiers dead supposedly, plus a Comman-
Off the Rails#179.dst: 不過我真的很好奇發生了什麼。她說那邊情況很糟，據說死了一大堆士兵，還有一位指揮——
Off the Rails#179.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#181.src: Every division of the Guard has a General leading it; she's ours.
Off the Rails#181.dst: 衛隊的每一支部隊都有一位將軍領導；她是我們的。
Off the Rails#181.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#183.src: We were just mindin' our business, roughin' up some... miscreants, and then she comes along an' drags us into bein' her guards for this whole shabang.
Off the Rails#183.dst: 我們本來只是在做自己的事，教訓幾個……刁民，然後她就跑來把我們拖進這整場鬧劇當她的護衛。
Off the Rails#183.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#184.src: ...Between you an' us... I don't think she woulda made us come along had she not been in a hurry...
Off the Rails#184.dst: ……我跟你講喔……我覺得她要不是趕時間，根本不會叫我們一起來……
Off the Rails#184.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#185.src: Yeah, more likely, she would have just fired us on the spot.
Off the Rails#185.dst: 對，比較可能的是她會當場把我們開除。
Off the Rails#185.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#186.src: SHHH. What if she overhears? Don't give 'er any ideas.
Off the Rails#186.dst: 噓。萬一她聽到怎麼辦？別給她出主意。
Off the Rails#186.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#187.src: Stories? What am I, yer mother at bedtime? Why would I tell you sto-
Off the Rails#187.dst: 故事？我是你媽在講床邊故事嗎？我幹嘛講故——
Off the Rails#187.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#188.src: We could tell them about the time we were assigned to {p}!
Off the Rails#188.dst: 我們可以跟他們講我們被派去 {p} 那次的事！
Off the Rails#188.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#189.src: Ohhh, yeah! I love that story. Great thinkin', Harvin.
Off the Rails#189.dst: 噢對耶！我最愛那個故事了。好主意，Harvin。
Off the Rails#189.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#190.src: So basically, there's this guy who comes up to us, an' he's all like "ooh i'm from house blahblah you must respect me..."
Off the Rails#190.dst: 總之，有個傢伙跑來找我們，一副「噢我是某某家的你們必須尊敬我」的樣子。
Off the Rails#190.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#191.src: Us, bein' from the Roughworks, don' give a damn about any 'a that. So he gets mad when we laugh in 'is face.
Off the Rails#191.dst: 我們是 Roughworks 出身的，根本不鳥那一套。所以我們當面笑他，他就火大了。
Off the Rails#191.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#193.src: ...accidentally knocks over a stall and gets himself totally covered in dyes!
Off the Rails#193.dst: ……不小心撞倒一個攤子，把自己弄得一身染料！
Off the Rails#193.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#194.src: YEAH, haha, his fancy clothes were ruined! It was awesome.
Off the Rails#194.dst: 對啦，哈哈，他那身高級衣服毀了！超讚的。
Off the Rails#194.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#195.src: Sadly, I think he actually had some influence, cause we've not been assigned to {p} since...
Off the Rails#195.dst: 可惜的是，我看他還真有點門路，因為那之後我們就再也沒被派去 {p} 過……
Off the Rails#195.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#196.src: Man, the {p} were beautiful, wish I could see them again.
Off the Rails#196.dst: 唉，{p} 真的很美，真希望能再看一次。
Off the Rails#196.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#198.src: The sewage incident is not to be spoken of.
Off the Rails#198.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#199.src: We are NOT tellin' you about that, kid.
Off the Rails#199.dst: 那件事我們「不會」告訴你的，小子。
Off the Rails#199.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#200.src: Then go away, kid. We have important things to do.
Off the Rails#200.dst: 那就走開吧，小子。我們有正事要辦。
Off the Rails#200.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#203.src: ...You again? Was it not clear enough that I wanted to be left alone?
Off the Rails#203.dst: ……又是你？我不想被打擾，這還不夠清楚嗎？
Off the Rails#203.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#207.src: You want to talk? Sigh, fine. Fine, I guess.
Off the Rails#207.dst: 你想聊天？唉，好吧。好吧，隨便你。

Off the Rails#209.src: Ugh. Well, see, I'm from {p}. I... don't like it there. So I wanted to see what the {p} was like.
Off the Rails#209.dst: 唉。這樣吧，我是 {p} 來的。我……不喜歡那裡。所以我想看看 {p} 是什麼樣子。
Off the Rails#209.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#210.src: Having been there yourself, I'm sure you understand well how that turned out. Now, I'm heading home.
Off the Rails#210.dst: 你自己也去過了，我相信你很清楚結果如何。現在，我要回家了。
Off the Rails#210.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#211.src: Really, at this point, I don't know if anywhere in this province is worth seeing. It must all be like that.
Off the Rails#211.dst: 老實說，到了這個地步，我不知道這個行省還有哪裡值得看。大概全都是那個樣子。
Off the Rails#211.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#212.src: ...But enough about me. What do you want to say?
Off the Rails#212.dst: ……不過我的事講夠了。你想說什麼？
Off the Rails#212.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#213.src: What do you want to say? (After initial dialogue)
Off the Rails#213.dst: 你想說什麼？(初次對話之後)
Off the Rails#213.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#214.src: Ugh... Anything else? (When the dialogue options reappear)
Off the Rails#214.dst: 唉……還有別的事嗎？(對話選項再次出現時)
Off the Rails#214.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#215.dst: 幹嘛？(後續與 Flinn 的對話)
Off the Rails#215.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#216.src: ...I have a lot of thinking to do, basically. It would be easier to do that if you left me alone... (After asking about the Military)
Off the Rails#216.dst: ……基本上，我有很多事要想。你別煩我的話會比較好想……(問過軍方之後)
Off the Rails#216.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#217.src: It's the same experience as before, just... different.
Off the Rails#217.dst: 跟之前是一樣的體驗，只是……不一樣了。
Off the Rails#217.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#218.src: The first time, I was amazed... It's so comfortable and nice... I was so excited to see what awaited me in {p}...
Off the Rails#218.dst: 第一次的時候我很驚豔……這麼舒服、這麼好……我那時好期待 {p} 有什麼在等著我……
Off the Rails#218.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#219.src: Now? It all just feels like a facade. I can't enjoy it the same way.
Off the Rails#219.dst: 現在呢？這一切都只像是個門面。我沒辦法再用同樣的心情享受它了。
Off the Rails#219.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#220.src: Oh, yeah, they're here, I guess.
Off the Rails#220.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#221.src: I don't really care, as long as they don't find some way to make my trip even worse...
Off the Rails#221.dst: 我不太在乎，只要他們別想辦法把我這趟旅程弄得更糟就好……
Off the Rails#221.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#222.src: They're agents of the Queen, and I don't really know what to think of that anymore. I can't tell if she hoards all the wealth for herself, or if she tells us everything's good just to make us happy.
Off the Rails#222.dst: 他們是女王的人，而我已經不知道該怎麼看待這件事了。我分不出來她是把財富全都囤給自己，還是只是告訴我們一切都好，好讓我們開心。
Off the Rails#222.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#223.src: Oh, hey again, friend. Nice to see ya!
Off the Rails#223.dst: 噢，嘿，又見面了，朋友。真高興看到你！
Off the Rails#223.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#224.src: The train's pretty nice, isn't it? If a bit... empty.
Off the Rails#224.dst: 這列車還不錯吧？雖然有點……空。
Off the Rails#224.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#225.src: I do wonder what was going on with the military presence... It's not every day that you see a General, after all.
Off the Rails#225.dst: 我真的很好奇軍方那陣仗是怎麼回事……畢竟不是每天都能看到一位將軍。
Off the Rails#225.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#226.src: Oh, hey, stranger. Looking for a chat? Sure, it'll help kill some time on the ride, I guess.
Off the Rails#226.dst: 噢，嘿，陌生人。想聊聊？好啊，反正路上也能打發時間。

Off the Rails#227.src: The name's Malic, nice to meet you. I'm guessing you'll be going to the same stop as me? To {p}?
Off the Rails#227.dst: 我叫 Malic，幸會。我猜你跟我要在同一站下車吧？去 {p}？
Off the Rails#227.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#228.src: I'm pretty excited about it. In the Roughworks, people never really get the opportunity to travel the Queen's Line. Too expensive for us, typically.
Off the Rails#228.dst: 我還蠻興奮的。在 Roughworks，人們幾乎沒有機會搭女王線。對我們來說通常太貴了。
Off the Rails#228.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#229.src: It's always been a dream of mine to see what other parts of Fruma are like, though, so I... well, I saved up for a long time.
Off the Rails#229.dst: 不過，看看 Fruma 其他地方長什麼樣子一直是我的夢想，所以我……嗯，存了很久的錢。
Off the Rails#229.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#230.src: Don't really know what the {p}'ll be like... I can't wait to find out. If it's anything like its Sovereign, it should be pretty great.
Off the Rails#230.dst: 我不太清楚 {p} 會是什麼樣子……真等不及要見識了。如果它跟它的統領有幾分像，那應該很不錯。
Off the Rails#230.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#231.src: Heh. Enough yammering from me, though. You probably have your own stuff you wanna talk about, right?
Off the Rails#231.dst: 呵。我話太多了。你大概也有自己想聊的事吧？
Off the Rails#231.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#232.src: ...Anyway, what do you want to talk about? (After initial dialogue)
Off the Rails#232.dst: ……總之，你想聊什麼？(初次對話之後)
Off the Rails#232.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#233.src: Anything else you wanna talk about? (When the dialogue options reappear)
Off the Rails#233.dst: 還有別的想聊的嗎？(對話選項再次出現時)
Off the Rails#233.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#234.src: Hey again! Anything to say? (Subsequent conversations with Malic)
Off the Rails#234.dst: 又見面啦！有話想說嗎？(後續與 Malic 的對話)
Off the Rails#234.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#235.src: ...Let's move on. (After asking about the Train)
Off the Rails#235.dst: ……我們換個話題吧。(問過列車之後)
Off the Rails#235.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#236.src: It's, uh, a lot different to the trains back home. Nicer.
Off the Rails#236.dst: 這，呃，跟我家鄉的列車差很多。好多了。
Off the Rails#236.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#237.src: See, I commute to work on the Industrial Sector Loop, for which I am fortunate enough to have a free pass.
Off the Rails#237.dst: 你看，我通勤上班是搭工業區環線，我很幸運有一張免費通行證。
Off the Rails#237.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#238.src: The trains there are... not like this. The seats are uncomfortable, it's usually packed with people, and it's never as clean.
Off the Rails#238.dst: 那邊的列車……跟這個不一樣。座位不舒服，通常擠滿了人，也從來沒這麼乾淨過。
Off the Rails#238.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#239.src: Why... Why are ours different? Why can't this quality be afforded to us..?
Off the Rails#239.dst: 為什麼……為什麼我們的就不一樣？為什麼這種品質不能也給我們？
Off the Rails#239.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#240.src: I'm very curious about their "important matters," it's highly unusual for them to travel with this amount of urgency.
Off the Rails#240.dst: 我對他們的「要緊事務」非常好奇，他們這麼急著趕路是很不尋常的。
Off the Rails#240.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#241.src: Typically, the military travel on their own trains, for safety and security. But for someone so important- the General of the Constables Division- to use a civilian train...
Off the Rails#241.dst: 軍方通常是搭自己的列車，為了安全與保密。但像她這麼重要的人——警備部隊的將軍——竟然用民用列車……
Off the Rails#241.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#242.src: ...the Constables Division... I'm... not fond of them, to be honest. I'm sure you've seen, but they patrol all over the Roughworks, and they're just... such bullies.
Off the Rails#242.dst: ……警備部隊……老實說，我對他們沒什麼好感。你大概看到了，他們在整個 Roughworks 巡邏，而且就是……那麼愛欺負人。
Off the Rails#242.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#243.src: They're always going around, roughing up people for not paying their rent, or stepping even slightly out of line...
Off the Rails#243.dst: 他們老是到處走動，只因為有人繳不出房租、或稍微越了一點線，就把人痛打一頓……
Off the Rails#243.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#244.src: I know the General said her activities wouldn't impact the trip, but... I'm not convinced. I hope it'll be okay.
Off the Rails#244.dst: 我知道將軍說她的行動不會影響這趟旅程，可是……我不太信。希望不會出事。
Off the Rails#244.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#245.src: I've not spoken to anyone else on the train, but maybe I should. Could hear some interesting things about their regions.
Off the Rails#245.dst: 車上其他人我都還沒說過話，不過也許我該去聊聊。說不定能聽到一些關於他們家鄉的有趣事情。
Off the Rails#245.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#246.src: Besides the attendant, Telati, I seem to be the only Roughworker here. To be expected, of course, since none of us can usually afford such a privilege.
Off the Rails#246.dst: 除了車勤員 Telati 之外，我好像是這裡唯一的 Roughworks 人。當然是意料之中，因為我們通常沒人負擔得起這種待遇。
Off the Rails#246.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#247.src: Hm. I'll think about socializing in a little bit. But for now, I'm pretty comfortable, honestly.
Off the Rails#247.dst: 嗯。等一下我再考慮去交際。不過老實說，現在這樣還蠻舒服的。
Off the Rails#247.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#248.src: Oh, hello. Looking for a conversation to pass some time? Sure thing.
Off the Rails#248.dst: 噢，你好。想找人聊天打發時間？沒問題。

Off the Rails#249.src: My name is Demma, and I'm a student from the Aelumia University.
Off the Rails#249.dst: 我叫 Demma，是 Aelumia 大學的學生。
Off the Rails#249.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#250.src: I'm traveling to Auburn for my study project... I can't wait!
Off the Rails#250.dst: 我要去 Auburn 做我的研究專題……真等不及了！
Off the Rails#250.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#251.src: See, I'm from the Blossom House. We study biology, and one of the highlights of the course is getting to travel and do fieldwork.
Off the Rails#251.dst: 你看，我是繁花學院的。我們研究生物學，而這門課最精彩的部分之一就是能出去做田野調查。
Off the Rails#251.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#252.src: I'm conducting a study of Fruma's snails- they've always fascinated me... They come in so many different shapes and sizes...
Off the Rails#252.dst: 我在做 Fruma 蝸牛的研究——牠們一直讓我著迷……牠們有那麼多不同的形狀跟大小……
Off the Rails#252.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#253.src: Auburn forest has some of the greatest... I can't wait to see a Gigastropod in person!
Off the Rails#253.dst: Auburn 森林裡有一些最了不起的……我真等不及要親眼看到 Gigastropod！
Off the Rails#253.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#254.src: Goodness, I must stop myself before I bore you with one of my rants. I do that all too often. What do you actually want to talk about? (After Demma's introduction)
Off the Rails#254.dst: 天啊，我得打住，不然又要用我的長篇大論把你煩死了。我很常這樣。你其實想聊什麼？(Demma 自我介紹之後)
Off the Rails#254.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#255.src: Got more to talk about? (Subsequent conversations with Demma)
Off the Rails#255.dst: 還有別的要聊嗎？(後續與 Demma 的對話)
Off the Rails#255.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#256.src: ...Let's move on. Anything else to discuss? (After asking about the University)
Off the Rails#256.dst: ……我們換個話題吧。還有別的想討論的嗎？(問過大學之後)
Off the Rails#256.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#257.src: ...Ah, sorry, I'm trailing off into tangents. Let's change topics. (After asking about the {p})
Off the Rails#257.dst: ……啊，抱歉，我又扯遠了。換個話題吧。(問過 {p} 之後)
Off the Rails#257.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#258.src: Gah! I need to stop going into tangents. Sorry. Let's change topics. (After asking about Biology)
Off the Rails#258.dst: 唉！我得改掉扯題外話的毛病。抱歉。換個話題吧。(問過生物學之後)
Off the Rails#258.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#259.src: ...Let's just... Move on to another subject. (After asking about Snails)
Off the Rails#259.dst: ……我們還是……換個話題吧。(問過蝸牛之後)
Off the Rails#259.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#260.src: Have you not heard of it? It's the most prestigious educational institution in the province!
Off the Rails#260.dst: 你沒聽過嗎？那是全行省最負盛名的教育機構！
Off the Rails#260.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#261.src: For those who like learning, it's the best place in the world to be... We've got a huge library with books on just about any topic you can think of!
Off the Rails#261.dst: 對喜歡學習的人來說，那是世界上最好的地方……我們有一座巨大的圖書館，幾乎你想得到的任何主題都有書！
Off the Rails#261.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#262.src: You can only really study one set of topics at a time though, sadly, unless you're super dedicated.
Off the Rails#262.dst: 可惜一次通常只能修一組主題，除非你非常拚。
Off the Rails#262.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#263.src: It's split into {~} different houses- Order, Crystal, Blossom, and Star- each with their own handful of subjects. I'm in Blossom, as previously stated.
Off the Rails#263.dst: 它分成 {~} 個學院——秩序、水晶、繁花、星辰——每個學院各有自己的幾門學科。我在繁花，剛才說過了。
Off the Rails#263.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#264.src: I chose Blossom for the biology, specifically. We also study history and fashion, but I care less about those.
Off the Rails#264.dst: 我選繁花學院，正是為了生物學。我們也學歷史和時尚，不過我對那些比較沒興趣。
Off the Rails#264.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#265.src: Almost no-one has ever taken two courses at once. The only exception I can think of is Sovereign Majin, who studied in Order and Star.
Off the Rails#265.dst: 幾乎沒有人同時修過兩門課程。我想得到的唯一例外是 Majin 統領，他在秩序和星辰都念過。
Off the Rails#265.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#266.src: He really can back up his big talk, huh...
Off the Rails#266.dst: 他那些大話還真的撐得起來呢……
Off the Rails#266.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#267.src: Honestly, I could care less about the culture there... It's cool and all, and learning the history of it has been fun, but...
Off the Rails#267.dst: 老實說，那裡的文化我沒那麼在意……是很酷啦，學它的歷史也很有趣，可是……
Off the Rails#267.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#268.src: The fauna is what I'm really interested in seeing! There's so many fascinating creatures in the region!
Off the Rails#268.dst: 我真正想看的是那裡的動物群！那個地區有好多迷人的生物！
Off the Rails#268.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#269.src: Snails aside, I've read so many interesting things about the region's wildlife. Elk that mimic trees, Beetles that hide amongst leaves, even fox-sized bats!
Off the Rails#269.dst: 撇開蝸牛不談，我讀過好多關於那個地區野生動物的有趣資料。會模仿樹木的麋鹿、藏在葉子間的甲蟲，還有狐狸那麼大的蝙蝠！
Off the Rails#269.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#270.src: It's been a joy reading about it, but it'll be even more amazing to see in person!
Off the Rails#270.dst: 光是讀就已經很享受了，親眼看到一定更驚人！
Off the Rails#270.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#271.src: You know, I'd love to go on a field study to the {p} too, someday. My teacher, Professor Pestal, has been there a couple times.
Off the Rails#271.dst: 你知道嗎，我也好想有一天能去 {p} 做田野研究。我的老師 Pestal 教授去過幾次。
Off the Rails#271.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#272.src: Apparently, it's so dangerous in there that you need to be constantly guarded by military professionals... But it would be so cool! I'd love to see a Kivaraptor in person!
Off the Rails#272.dst: 聽說那裡危險到你得全程有軍方專業人員護衛……但那一定超酷的！我好想親眼看到 Kivaraptor！
Off the Rails#272.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#273.src: From a young age, I've always loved animals. so joining Blossom House at the university just made sense.
Off the Rails#273.dst: 我從小就一直很愛動物，所以進大學選繁花學院是很自然的事。
Off the Rails#273.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#274.src: I grew up in {p}, so I've not seen much wildlife besides the limited amount that live in the city, plus some from travelling zoos.
Off the Rails#274.dst: 我在 {p} 長大，所以除了城裡有限的那些、加上一些巡迴動物園的動物之外，我沒見過多少野生動物。
Off the Rails#274.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#275.src: It's been wonderful having the opportunity to go out and see more of it in person. We already did a field study in the {p}, which was amazing.
Off the Rails#275.dst: 能有機會出去親眼看到更多，實在太美好了。我們已經在 {p} 做過一次田野研究，那次超棒的。
Off the Rails#275.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#276.src: Professor Pestal - my teacher - has been all over the place studying the province's fauna. I'd love to be like him someday.
Off the Rails#276.dst: Pestal 教授——我的老師——為了研究行省的動物群跑遍了各地。我好希望有一天能像他那樣。
Off the Rails#276.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#277.src: Hey... On that note, see that girl sat over there? That's actually his daughter, Maddison. It's crazy running into her here.
Off the Rails#277.dst: 嘿……說到這個，看到坐在那邊那個女生了嗎？那其實是他女兒 Maddison。在這裡遇到她真是太巧了。
Off the Rails#277.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#278.src: I've spoken to her before- she's nice. Very curious, always wanted to explore the province, looks like she's finally gotten her wis-
Off the Rails#278.dst: 我以前跟她說過話——她人很好。很好奇，一直想去探索這個行省，看來她終於如願——
Off the Rails#278.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#279.src: Oh, do NOT get me started on snails. I've always loved those little guys. They're so cute, and so interesting!
Off the Rails#279.dst: 噢，「千萬別」讓我開始講蝸牛。我一直都很愛那些小傢伙。牠們好可愛，又好有趣！
Off the Rails#279.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#280.src: Did you know that they're not bugs as commonly ascribed, but rather, more related to aquatic creatures?
Off the Rails#280.dst: 你知道嗎，牠們其實不像大家以為的那樣是蟲，反而跟水生生物比較近緣？
Off the Rails#280.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#281.src: It's really fascinating! They're also so different to creatures as we tend to understand them.
Off the Rails#281.dst: 真的很迷人！而且牠們跟我們一般理解的生物差別很大。
Off the Rails#281.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#282.src: They're hermaphrodites, which means that any two snails can breed! And, they-
Off the Rails#282.dst: 牠們是雌雄同體，也就是說任何兩隻蝸牛都能繁殖！而且，牠們——
Off the Rails#282.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#283.src: Actually, maybe that's not an appropriate topic of conversation. Well, okay, I can think of something else...
Off the Rails#283.dst: 呃，也許這不是適合聊天的話題。好吧，那我想想別的……
Off the Rails#283.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#284.src: Did you know they have thousands of little teeth? They also can't hear!
Off the Rails#284.dst: 你知道牠們有好幾千顆小牙齒嗎？而且牠們聽不見！
Off the Rails#284.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#285.src: Yet, despite these differences, they like, understand us! They show signs of enjoying human contact!
Off the Rails#285.dst: 然而，儘管有這些差異，牠們居然能理解我們！牠們會表現出享受人類接觸的跡象！
Off the Rails#285.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#286.src: There's also so many different species of snail, like the one I'm studying, the Gigastropod!!!
Off the Rails#286.dst: 而且蝸牛的種類也超多，像我在研究的這種，Gigastropod！！！
Off the Rails#286.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#287.src: Did you know that Gigastropod shells are tougher than concrete? You can stand on them and the creature will be fine!
Off the Rails#287.dst: 你知道 Gigastropod 的殼比混凝土還硬嗎？你站上去牠都不會有事！
Off the Rails#287.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#288.src: ...Though, I don't advise doing that- it's probably really scary for the poor snail.
Off the Rails#288.dst: ……不過我不建議這樣做——那對可憐的蝸牛來說大概很可怕。
Off the Rails#288.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#289.src: Apparently, back in the horrible Great Auburn Flood - you know - the one that kickstarted the New Age...
Off the Rails#289.dst: 據說在那場可怕的 Auburn 大洪水的時候——你知道的——就是開啟新紀元的那一場……
Off the Rails#289.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#290.src: ...People survived by clinging onto the Gigastropods, because despite their hardy shells, they're also buoyant!
Off the Rails#290.dst: ……人們是靠攀住 Gigastropod 活下來的，因為牠們的殼雖然堅硬，卻也能浮起來！
Off the Rails#290.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#291.src: Speaking of the dam, isn't it fascinating that Gigastropods are so closely related to the Murex Mollusc despite the sheer cliff between them?
Off the Rails#291.dst: 說到水壩，Gigastropod 和 Murex Mollusc 之間隔著一整面陡崖，卻是如此近緣，這不是很迷人嗎？
Off the Rails#291.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#292.src: Don't stand on Murex Molluscs though, they're toxic! Plus, their shells aren't as strong.
Off the Rails#292.dst: 不過別站到 Murex Mollusc 上面，牠們有毒！而且牠們的殼也沒那麼硬。
Off the Rails#292.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#293.src: Did you know that their slime-
Off the Rails#293.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#294.src: OH, GOODNESS! I'm so sorry! I... I got carried away.
Off the Rails#294.dst: 噢，天啊！真的很抱歉！我……我又講得太忘我了。
Off the Rails#294.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#295.src: I've got a really bad habit of just... infodumping. I'm so sorry.
Off the Rails#295.dst: 我有個很糟的習慣，就是會一直……傾倒資訊。真的很抱歉。
Off the Rails#295.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#298.src: Gosh, we're going to arrive in {p} soon... It's quite exciting, isn't it?
Off the Rails#298.dst: 天啊，我們快到 {p} 了……蠻興奮的，對吧？
Off the Rails#298.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#299.src: I do wonder what was going on with the military activity back in the station... It was cool to see, but...
Off the Rails#299.dst: 我真的很好奇車站那邊軍方在忙什麼……看起來是很酷啦，可是……
Off the Rails#299.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#300.src: I just hope it doesn't ruin our trip, somehow...
Off the Rails#300.dst: 我只希望那不會用某種方式毀了我們的旅程……
Off the Rails#300.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#301.src: ...Anyway, is there anything you'd like to talk about? (After initial dialogue)
Off the Rails#301.dst: ……總之，有什麼你想聊的嗎？(初次對話之後)
Off the Rails#301.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#302.src: ...Anything else you'd like to discuss? (When the dialogue options reappear)
Off the Rails#302.dst: ……還有別的想討論的嗎？(對話選項再次出現時)
Off the Rails#302.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#303.src: Hi again! Want to talk? (Subsequent conversations with Maddison)
Off the Rails#303.dst: 又見面啦！想聊聊嗎？(後續與 Maddison 的對話)
Off the Rails#303.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#304.src: The train's really cool to ride around on. The spectacle of it hasn't worn off on me, and this is my third time experiencing it!
Off the Rails#304.dst: 搭這列車真的很酷。那種新鮮感到現在都還沒消退，而這已經是我第三次搭了！
Off the Rails#304.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#305.src: In this area, I'm noticing a bunch of murals in the tunnels... It's fun to watch them, I just wish I could catch the details better.
Off the Rails#305.dst: 在這一段，我注意到隧道裡有好多壁畫……看著很有趣，只可惜我看不清楚細節。
Off the Rails#305.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#306.src: Can you imagine how beautiful it would be if the train was on the surface instead of underground? You'd get some amazing views of the province, I bet...
Off the Rails#306.dst: 你能想像如果列車跑在地面上而不是地底下，會有多美嗎？我打賭能看到行省一些驚人的景色……
Off the Rails#306.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#307.src: I do wonder why the train only runs underground. Safety, maybe?
Off the Rails#307.dst: 我真的很好奇為什麼列車只在地下跑。也許是為了安全？
Off the Rails#307.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#308.src: Having grown up in Aelumia, I'm pretty familiar with the Guard's upper ranks. There's military parades all the time, you know!
Off the Rails#308.dst: 在 Aelumia 長大，我對衛隊的高階軍官還蠻熟悉的。那裡常常有閱兵，你知道嗎！
Off the Rails#308.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#309.src: That scary lady we saw back there? That was General Levi, the leader of the Constables Division.
Off the Rails#309.dst: 剛剛我們看到那位嚇人的女士？那是 Levi 將軍，警備部隊的領導者。
Off the Rails#309.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#310.src: She took on the role a few years ago, when the previous General, General Daimyo, stepped down. She's pretty cool, it was a nice surprise seeing her here!
Off the Rails#310.dst: 她是幾年前接下這個職位的，前一任的 Daimyo 將軍卸任之後。她蠻厲害的，能在這裡看到她是個不錯的驚喜！
Off the Rails#310.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#311.src: I do wonder what calls for such urgency though... Usually, she has her Commanders handle most things. For her to need to handle something personally, and on a civilian train...
Off the Rails#311.dst: 不過我真的很好奇是什麼事這麼緊急……平常她大多讓底下的指揮官處理。要她親自出馬，還搭民用列車……
Off the Rails#311.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#312.src: ...Well, she did ask that we stay out of it, so I guess I shouldn't get too curious.
Off the Rails#312.dst: ……嗯，她確實叫我們別插手，所以我想我不該太好奇。
Off the Rails#312.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#313.src: I talked to a few people when I first boarded, but now I'm just going to relax. I'll probably talk to more people later when I get bored.
Off the Rails#313.dst: 剛上車的時候我跟幾個人聊過，現在我只想放鬆一下。等等無聊了大概會再去找人聊。
Off the Rails#313.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#314.src: The first person I tried talking to was the attendant, Telati, but he seemed... stressed, so I just let him be.
Off the Rails#314.dst: 我第一個試著搭話的是車勤員 Telati，但他看起來……很有壓力，所以我就沒打擾他。
Off the Rails#314.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#315.src: Then... See her over there? The girl with the glasses? That's Demma, one of my dad's students. We spoke for a bit, it was nice to see her!
Off the Rails#315.dst: 然後……看到那邊那位了嗎？戴眼鏡的女生？那是 Demma，我爸的學生之一。我們聊了一下，能看到她真好！
Off the Rails#315.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#316.src: Lastly, I tried speaking to the posh guy in the canteen, but... he said he was at a good part in his book, so I just left him alone.
Off the Rails#316.dst: 最後，我試著跟餐車裡那位氣派的先生講話，但……他說他讀到書裡精彩的部分，所以我就不打擾他了。
Off the Rails#316.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#317.src: Sigh, what is it? You want to talk? To me?
Off the Rails#317.dst: 唉，什麼事？你想聊天？跟我？
Off the Rails#317.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#318.src: ...Fine. I suppose I can indulge. But you had better leave me to read my book in peace when you're done.
Off the Rails#318.dst: ……好吧。我想我可以奉陪。不過你講完之後最好讓我安靜地看我的書。
Off the Rails#318.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#319.src: I am Cemor, of House Efelu, a noble house of small repute, though soon it shall surely rise.
Off the Rails#319.dst: 我是 Cemor，Efelu 家的人，一個聲望不高的貴族家族，不過想必很快就會崛起。
Off the Rails#319.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#320.src: I'm travelling from my home, the {p}, to Auburn. Why? Well, I booked a ticket to go to the Festival of the Queen, but... for the wrong date.
Off the Rails#320.dst: 我從我的家鄉 {p} 要去 Auburn。為什麼？嗯，我訂了去看女王慶典的票，但是……訂錯了日期。
Off the Rails#320.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#321.src: I didn't want that money to go to waste, so I'm going to go and visit {p} anyway. There's probably some festival left to experience.
Off the Rails#321.dst: 我不想讓那筆錢白花，所以還是決定去 {p} 一趟。想必還會剩下一些慶典可以體驗。
Off the Rails#321.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#322.src: But enough about little old me. What do you want to talk about? (After Cemor's introduction)
Off the Rails#322.dst: 不過我這點小事就講到這裡。你想聊什麼？(Cemor 自我介紹之後)
Off the Rails#322.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#323.src: What is it now? (Subsequent conversations with Cemor)
Off the Rails#323.dst: 這次又怎麼了？(後續與 Cemor 的對話)
Off the Rails#323.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#324.src: But let us move on from that. What else have you to discuss? (After asking about the Book)
Off the Rails#324.dst: 不過我們就此打住吧。你還有什麼要討論的？(問過那本書之後)
Off the Rails#324.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#325.src: Let us move on. What else would you like to speak about? (After asking about the {p})
Off the Rails#325.dst: 換個話題吧。你還想聊些什麼？(問過 {p} 之後)
Off the Rails#325.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#326.src: Moving on. What else is there to speak of? (After asking about the {p})
Off the Rails#326.dst: 繼續下去吧。還有什麼好談的？(問過 {p} 之後)
Off the Rails#326.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#327.src: ...Anywho. Anything else? (After asking about the Train)
Off the Rails#327.dst: ……總之。還有別的事嗎？(問過列車之後)
Off the Rails#327.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#328.src: Ah, yes. The book. It's very good, I'm glad I chose to bring it with me.
Off the Rails#328.dst: 啊，是的。那本書。非常好看，我很慶幸自己把它帶上了。
Off the Rails#328.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#329.src: It's called "The Long-Winded and Painful Death of Greenie S. Sweenville," which, I hope, speaks for itself.
Off the Rails#329.dst: 書名叫《Greenie S. Sweenville 冗長而痛苦的死亡》，我想，這書名已經足以說明一切了。
Off the Rails#329.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#330.src: One of the members of my book club back in {p} recommended it to me. I'm glad they did- it's a beautiful story.
Off the Rails#330.dst: 是我在 {p} 讀書會的一位成員推薦給我的。我很慶幸他們推薦了——那是個美麗的故事。
Off the Rails#330.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#331.src: It's a shame... The Auburn Festival is usually quite good. A few of us Highlanders go down to Auburn to see it.
Off the Rails#331.dst: 可惜啊……Auburn 慶典通常辦得相當不錯。我們高地人會有幾個下去 Auburn 看。
Off the Rails#331.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#332.src: They have games, beautiful cuisine, and a band... Who knew Auburn could put on such a wonderful show.
Off the Rails#332.dst: 他們有遊戲、美味的菜餚，還有樂隊……誰想得到 Auburn 辦得出這麼精彩的場面。
Off the Rails#332.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#333.src: I think it's that Sovereign Zhiraok- I hear he busies himself trying to atone for his family's failures. I'd feel bad, if not for him being a Nasin.
Off the Rails#333.dst: 我想是因為那位 Zhiraok 統領吧——聽說他忙著替他家族的過失贖罪。要不是他姓 Nasin，我還會替他難過呢。
Off the Rails#333.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#334.src: Our own festival is quite a sight to see, too. I'd recommend visiting, but they make those tickets too expensive for the lower regions, don't they?
Off the Rails#334.dst: 我們自己的慶典也很值得一看。我會推薦你去，不過他們把那些票的價格訂得下面幾個地區負擔不起，不是嗎？
Off the Rails#334.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#336.src: Ah, the {p}. Gorgeous place, perhaps the real crown jewel of Fruma.
Off the Rails#336.dst: 啊，{p}。美極了的地方，或許才是 Fruma 真正的王冠上的寶石。
Off the Rails#336.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#337.src: I question why the Queen doesn't come and live amongst us. Perhaps she fears the people, hence her home being a fortress.
Off the Rails#337.dst: 我很納悶女王為什麼不搬來跟我們同住。也許她害怕人民，所以她的居所才是一座要塞。
Off the Rails#337.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#338.src: Our Sovereign, Majin... He spends far too much of his time trying to outcompete that Nasin, as would a Thalas.
Off the Rails#338.dst: 我們的統領 Majin……他花太多時間想壓過那個 Nasin，不愧是 Thalas 家的作風。
Off the Rails#338.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#339.src: He should keep his sights on his own region... The Nasins are already disgraced; what does he have to prove?
Off the Rails#339.dst: 他該把目光放在自己的地區上……Nasin 家早就名譽掃地了；他還有什麼好證明的？
Off the Rails#339.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#340.src: It's... alright, I suppose. I've had worse train rides.
Off the Rails#340.dst: 還……可以吧，我想。我搭過更糟的列車。
Off the Rails#340.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#341.src: I've also had better train rides, though... Usually, there is another caterer.
Off the Rails#341.dst: 不過我也搭過更好的……通常會有另一位餐飲人員。
Off the Rails#341.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#342.src: We'll see how the one caterer does preparing my meal. It's my favourite, whole roast Grookiva, and that's not particularly hard to prepare, so...
Off the Rails#342.dst: 我們就看看這唯一一位怎麼準備我的餐點吧。那是我的最愛，整隻烤 Grookiva，而那並不特別難做，所以……
Off the Rails#342.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#343.src: Ugh. Then leave me to my book in peace, please.
Off the Rails#343.dst: 唉。那就請讓我安靜地看我的書吧。
Off the Rails#343.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#345.src: ...Oh, Harvin, GODDAMNIT HARVIN... We're NOT gettin' let off the hook for this one! We're SCREWED.
Off the Rails#345.dst: ……噢，Harvin，「該死的」Harvin……這次我們絕對脫不了身！我們「完蛋了」。
Off the Rails#345.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#346.src: ...God Maury, with a messup this bad, they'll send us to Deraj for sure! You know what they do to people in Deraj!!!
Off the Rails#346.dst: ……天啊 Maury，捅出這麼大的簍子，他們肯定把我們送去 Deraj！你知道他們在 Deraj 怎麼對人的！！！
Off the Rails#346.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#349.src: This is YOUR fault, ya idiot! Where the hell were YOU when I was takin' a nap?
Off the Rails#349.dst: 這是「你」的錯，你這蠢貨！我在睡覺的時候「你」跑到哪去了？
Off the Rails#349.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#350.src: Yeah? What were YOU doing napping on the job? What else was I supposed to do when I needed the bathroom?
Off the Rails#350.dst: 是喔？那你上班時間跑去睡覺又是怎麼回事？我想上廁所還能怎麼辦？
Off the Rails#350.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#353.src: If we catch the perpetrator, we'll be... redeemed! Yeah!
Off the Rails#353.dst: 如果我們抓到兇手，就能……將功折罪！對！
Off the Rails#353.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#354.src: Good idea, but how the hell're we gonna catch them? That sounds... hard.
Off the Rails#354.dst: 好主意，可是我們到底要怎麼抓？那聽起來……很難。
Off the Rails#354.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#356.dst: ……你在想的跟我想的是同一件事嗎？
Off the Rails#356.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#358.src: Ye're under arrest for the murder of General Levi, punk!
Off the Rails#358.dst: 你因謀殺 Levi 將軍被捕了，臭小子！
Off the Rails#358.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#360.src: Evidence? Heh, They'll believe it - ye're suspicious-lookin', and have some oddd tools on yer person. Don't think we haven't seen 'em.
Off the Rails#360.dst: 證據？呵，他們會信的——你看起來就很可疑，身上還帶著一些怪工具。別以為我們沒看見。
Off the Rails#360.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#361.src: Yeah, what region are you from, anyway? The Secret {p} Civilization? Ha! NOBODY goes around dressed like you.
Off the Rails#361.dst: 對啊，話說你到底是哪一區來的？{p} 的秘密文明嗎？哈！「沒有人」會穿成你這樣。
Off the Rails#361.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#362.src: Hey! You can't just accuse them without evidence! That's not fair!
Off the Rails#362.dst: 喂！你們不能沒有證據就這樣指控他們！這不公平！
Off the Rails#362.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#363.src: Do ya wanna be put down as an accomplice in the murder? Shut yer trap!
Off the Rails#363.dst: 你想被列為謀殺案的共犯嗎？閉上你的嘴！
Off the Rails#363.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#364.src: But- but they were asleep the entire time! I saw it!
Off the Rails#364.dst: 可是——可是他們全程都在睡覺！我親眼看到的！
Off the Rails#364.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#365.src: ...Egh... Fine... Tell ya what. New idea.
Off the Rails#365.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#366.src: You n' I... We're gonna play a little game.
Off the Rails#366.dst: 你跟我……我們來玩個小遊戲。
Off the Rails#366.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#367.src: If you can prove yer innocence before the train reaches the station... Ye're free to go. Otherwise? We go with Plan A.
Off the Rails#367.dst: 如果你能在列車到站前證明自己的清白……你就可以走。不然呢？我們就照原計畫辦。
Off the Rails#367.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#368.src: All of you, out. This is private business. Get back to yer seats.
Off the Rails#368.dst: 你們全部出去。這是私事。回自己的座位。
Off the Rails#368.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#369.src: Alright. Uhh. The best way to prove that ye're innocent would probably be to figure out who actually did it.
Off the Rails#369.dst: 好。呃。要證明你的清白，最好的辦法大概是查出到底是誰幹的。
Off the Rails#369.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#370.src: If yer gonna be playin' detective, you're gonna want somewhere to jot yer findings, right? Where are we gonna get ya somethin' like that...
Off the Rails#370.dst: 既然你要當偵探，總得有個地方記錄你的發現吧？我們去哪弄一本那種東西……
Off the Rails#370.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#371.src: Don't worry, Maury, I have just the thing!
Off the Rails#371.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#372.src: Yer notebook? The one you were supposed ta use for documentin' suspicious activity?
Off the Rails#372.dst: 你的筆記本？那本你本來該用來記錄可疑活動的？
Off the Rails#372.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#373.src: Yeah, I never bothered with it.
Off the Rails#373.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#375.src: Uh. Anyway. You. Yeah. A good place to start yer investigation would be the scene of the crime, probably.
Off the Rails#375.dst: 呃。總之。你。對。你調查的起點，大概該從案發現場開始。
Off the Rails#375.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#376.src: Go poke around at the body and see what ya can find.
Off the Rails#376.dst: 去屍體那邊翻翻看，看你能找到什麼。
Off the Rails#376.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#377.src: Inspect the General's corpse to find clues.
Off the Rails#377.dst: 檢查將軍的屍體以尋找線索。

Off the Rails#379.src: Hey, do you need that? Is that gonna help you with the case?
Off the Rails#379.dst: 喂，你需要那個嗎？那對你辦案有幫助嗎？
Off the Rails#379.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#381.src: Interestin' evidence... this seems highly premeditated, if ya ask me...
Off the Rails#381.dst: 有意思的證據……要我說，這看起來是精心預謀的……
Off the Rails#381.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#382.src: Well, anyway, that ain't for us ta worry about. You're gonna figure out who did this.
Off the Rails#382.dst: 嗯，反正那不是我們該操心的。你才是那個要查出兇手的人。
Off the Rails#382.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#383.src: Ya should go around an' talk to yer fellow passengers, see if they got any dirt. Ya might also spot some physical evidence along the way...
Off the Rails#383.dst: 你該去跟其他乘客聊聊，看他們有沒有什麼內幕。路上說不定也能發現一些實物證據……
Off the Rails#383.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#384.src: Hey, Maury... How are we gonna stop them from just accusing someone random? There would be no point to any of this, and we'd might as well just arrest them instead...
Off the Rails#384.dst: 喂，Maury……我們要怎麼阻止他們隨便亂指一個人？那樣這一切就沒意義了，我們乾脆直接把他們抓起來算了……
Off the Rails#384.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#386.src: Ye're gonna have to find some compelling pieces of evidence, I guess. We'll say {~}.
Off the Rails#386.dst: 那你就得找出幾件有力的證據吧。我們就說 {~} 件好了。
Off the Rails#386.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#387.src: Once ya have {~} pieces of strong evidence, come back ta us and make yer accusation.
Off the Rails#387.dst: 等你手上有 {~} 件有力的證據，再回來找我們提出指控。
Off the Rails#387.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#388.src: Look around and interrogate passengers to find at least {~} pieces of strong evidence.
Off the Rails#388.dst: 四處查看並盤問乘客，找出至少 {~} 件有力的證據。

Off the Rails#389.src: * Left-Click to pick up or drop pieces
Off the Rails#389.dst: * 左鍵點擊以拿起或放下拼塊
Off the Rails#389.speaker: Controls

Off the Rails#390.src: * Click to select a column or row
Off the Rails#390.dst: * 點擊以選擇一欄或一列
Off the Rails#390.speaker: Controls

Off the Rails#391.src: Oh, it's you again. You... Those guards were wrong, right? ...Would they accuse someone randomly..?
Off the Rails#391.dst: 噢，又是你。你……那些衛兵搞錯了吧？……他們會隨便指控一個人嗎……？
Off the Rails#391.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#393.src: Well... I guess those guards are having you hunt for who else could've done it, so I suppose it is my duty as a citizen to assist.
Off the Rails#393.dst: 嗯……我想那些衛兵是要你去找出還有誰可能下手，那麼身為市民，協助你應該是我的責任。
Off the Rails#393.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#394.src: Besides, taking questions from you might help me not think about certain things. Like that I'm going to have to clean up that body later.
Off the Rails#394.dst: 何況，回答你的問題也許能讓我不去想某些事。比如說我等一下得去清理那具屍體。
Off the Rails#394.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#396.src: Oh, you're the one from the murder scene, aren't you? The one those guards accused?
Off the Rails#396.dst: 噢，你就是命案現場那個人吧？被那些衛兵指控的那個？
Off the Rails#396.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#397.src: ...You didn't actually do it, right? ...Would guards accuse someone randomly..?
Off the Rails#397.dst: ……你不是真的做了吧？……衛兵會隨便指控一個人嗎……？
Off the Rails#397.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#399.src: Well... I guess those guards are having you hunt for who else could've done it, so I suppose it is my duty as a citizen to assist.
Off the Rails#399.dst: 嗯……我想那些衛兵是要你去找出還有誰可能下手，那麼身為市民，協助你應該是我的責任。
Off the Rails#399.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#400.src: As I told you back when you boarded, my name's Telati. I'm... the only staffer on the train today. Besides the driver, Cusef, but he's busy, well, driving.
Off the Rails#400.dst: 你上車的時候我說過了，我叫 Telati。我是……今天車上唯一的工作人員。除了司機 Cusef，不過他忙著，嗯，開車。
Off the Rails#400.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#401.src: That means I'm the only person here to attend our many passengers today. And... The only person here to deal with this horrible crisis. To clean up the mess.
Off the Rails#401.dst: 也就是說今天這麼多旅客，只有我一個人在服務。而且……也只有我一個人要面對這場可怕的危機。要去清理那攤爛攤子。
Off the Rails#401.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#402.src: It's... It's... Sigh. I'm stressed, alright?
Off the Rails#402.dst: 這……這……唉。我壓力很大，好嗎？
Off the Rails#402.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#404.src: ...What questions do you have? (After initial conversation)
Off the Rails#404.dst: ……你有什麼問題？(初次對話之後)
Off the Rails#404.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#405.src: Anything wrong? Or do you have more questions? (Subsequent conversations with Telati)
Off the Rails#405.dst: 有什麼不對嗎？還是你還有問題？(後續與 Telati 的對話)
Off the Rails#405.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#406.src: Any more questions? (After asking about what Telati saw before the murder)
Off the Rails#406.dst: 還有問題嗎？(問過 Telati 在命案前看到什麼之後)
Off the Rails#406.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#407.src: Anything else to say...? (After choosing any purple dialogue option)
Off the Rails#407.dst: 還有別的話要說嗎……？(選過任何紫色對話選項之後)
Off the Rails#407.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#408.src: Ah, of course. Staffing the train, I've seen a lot today. Let me recount.
Off the Rails#408.dst: 啊，當然。在車上工作，我今天看到不少。讓我從頭說起。
Off the Rails#408.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#409.src: Well, for starters... I was loitering in this carriage, just trying to avoid Cemor. I... didn't want to make his meal.
Off the Rails#409.dst: 首先……我一直待在這節車廂閒晃，就是為了避開 Cemor。我……不想做他那道餐點。
Off the Rails#409.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#410.src: Yes, it was wrong of me. I ought to apologise to him... Anyway, he showed up here to go to the bathroom, so I quickly left before he could talk to me.
Off the Rails#410.dst: 是，這樣是我不對。我應該向他道歉……總之，他來這裡上廁所，所以我在他來得及跟我說話之前趕快離開了。
Off the Rails#410.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#411.src: I headed down to the passenger carriages and spoke to everyone I saw. I was a little stressed, so I don't remember the specifics.
Off the Rails#411.dst: 我往乘客車廂走，跟沿路看到的每個人都講了話。我當時有點焦躁，所以細節記不太清楚。
Off the Rails#411.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#412.src: Well, not everyone, I suppose. You were asleep. Malic and I had a chuckle about it.
Off the Rails#412.dst: 嗯，也不是每個人，我想。你當時在睡覺。Malic 和我還為此笑了一下。
Off the Rails#412.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#413.src: I also didn't speak to the guards... One was asleep in the same carriage as you, and the other started walking towards the back carriage when I came by.
Off the Rails#413.dst: 衛兵我也沒跟他們講到話……一個在你那節車廂睡覺，另一個在我經過的時候正往車尾走。
Off the Rails#413.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#414.src: I made my way back to the back and encountered Demma and Cemor on the way back to their seats. I made sure to dash by Cemor.
Off the Rails#414.dst: 我往車尾走回去，路上遇到 Demma 和 Cemor 正要回自己的座位。我特地快步從 Cemor 旁邊閃過。
Off the Rails#414.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#415.src: I was going back to loitering when suddenly, the purple guard came barging in shouting for his compatriot, who was in the bathroom.
Off the Rails#415.dst: 我正要回去繼續閒晃，那名紫衣衛兵突然衝進來，大喊著找他的同伴，他同伴在廁所裡。
Off the Rails#415.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#416.src: Concerned, I followed the two of them, to find that they has found Levi's corpse. Before I could ask questions, they were off running through the train yelling.
Off the Rails#416.dst: 我很擔心，就跟著他們兩個過去，結果發現他們找到了 Levi 的屍體。我還來不及問問題，他們就一路穿過列車大喊著跑掉了。
Off the Rails#416.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#418.src: Sure, I do have a master key for all rooms I can lend you. Let me find it...
Off the Rails#418.dst: 當然，我有一把所有房間都能開的萬能鑰匙可以借你。讓我找一下……
Off the Rails#418.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#419.src: ...W-Whuh? Where is it? I always keep it somewhere in my pocket! Perhaps I dropped it somewhere?
Off the Rails#419.dst: ……咦、咦？它在哪裡？我一向都放在口袋裡的！難道我掉在哪裡了？
Off the Rails#419.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#420.src: Oh no... Maybe the killer stole it! Maybe that's how they got into the room!
Off the Rails#420.dst: 糟了……說不定是兇手偷走了！說不定他們就是這樣進到房裡的！
Off the Rails#420.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#421.src: ...Oh, no no no no... It can't be my fault... It can't...
Off the Rails#421.dst: ……噢，不不不不……不可能是我的錯……不可能……
Off the Rails#421.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#422.src: Please, you must find that key. It must be on the train somewhere.
Off the Rails#422.dst: 拜託，你一定要找到那把鑰匙。它一定還在列車上的某個地方。
Off the Rails#422.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#423.src: Wait, You did? But I have it right h-
Off the Rails#423.dst: 等等，你找到了？可是我明明就放在這——
Off the Rails#423.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#424.src: ...W-Whuh? I guess I must have dropped it at some point.
Off the Rails#424.dst: ……咦、咦？看來我真的在哪裡掉了。
Off the Rails#424.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#425.src: Oh no... Maybe the killer stole it! Maybe that's how they got into the room!
Off the Rails#425.dst: 糟了……說不定是兇手偷走了！說不定他們就是這樣進到房裡的！
Off the Rails#425.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#426.src: Feel free to use it as needed for your investigation... You're free to enter the janitor's closet.
Off the Rails#426.dst: 調查需要的話儘管用……你可以進清潔間。
Off the Rails#426.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#427.src: Oh, thank goodness you found it. Thank you so much.
Off the Rails#427.dst: 噢，謝天謝地你找到了。真的太感謝你了。
Off the Rails#427.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#428.src: Feel free to use it anywhere you need. You may even enter the janitor's closet, if you'd like.
Off the Rails#428.dst: 需要的地方儘管用。你想的話，連清潔間都可以進去。
Off the Rails#428.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#429.src: A book? In the closet? Hm, I'm not much of a reader, so I doubt it was mine...
Off the Rails#429.dst: 一本書？在清潔間裡？唔，我不太看書，所以那應該不是我的……
Off the Rails#429.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#430.src: ...It was used to hide the knife, you say? That's... worrying.
Off the Rails#430.dst: ……你說它被用來藏那把刀？那……令人不安。
Off the Rails#430.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#431.src: Perhaps the murderer used the closet as something of a staging ground for their attack...
Off the Rails#431.dst: 也許兇手把那間清潔間當成了下手前的準備地點……
Off the Rails#431.speaker: Telati
