Off the Rails#432.src: Oh, no, did he really not forget? Damnit. Damnit damnit damnit.
Off the Rails#432.dst: 噢，不會吧，他真的沒忘記？該死。該死該死該死。
Off the Rails#432.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#433.src: ...Listen. I'm- I'm really quite stressed, alright? I didn't think I'd be able to make that recipe before, let alone now.
Off the Rails#433.dst: ……聽我說。我、我壓力真的很大，好嗎？我之前就覺得自己做不出那道菜，何況是現在。
Off the Rails#433.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#434.src: I'm... I'm so sorry to ask you this, but... Could you please make the meal for him? He wanted whole roast Grookiva.
Off the Rails#434.dst: 我……我真的很不好意思開這個口，可是……可以請你替他做那道餐點嗎？他要的是整隻烤 Grookiva。
Off the Rails#434.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#435.src: My absent colleagu, Zathie, left a recipe book that you can use. I'm sure you can follow it better than I ever could.
Off the Rails#435.dst: 我那位不在的同事 Zathie 留了一本食譜給你用。我相信你一定比我照著做得更好。
Off the Rails#435.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#436.src: I give you my full permission to enter the kitchen for this task, it's in the canteen carriage. Thank you for this.
Off the Rails#436.dst: 我完全授權你為此進入廚房，就在餐車車廂。謝謝你。
Off the Rails#436.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#437.src: Oh, alright then. Have a good trip!
Off the Rails#437.dst: 噢，那好吧。祝您旅途愉快！
Off the Rails#437.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#438.src: Ugh, what is it now? (Initial conversations with Harvin and Maury)
Off the Rails#438.dst: 唉，這次又怎樣？(與 Harvin 和 Maury 的初次對話)
Off the Rails#438.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#439.src: None of it matters now, though. Anythin' else? (After asking about What were you doing on the train)
Off the Rails#439.dst: 不過現在那都不重要了。還有別的嗎？(問過「你們在列車上做什麼」之後)
Off the Rails#439.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#440.src: Sorry, kid. Anythin' else to ask? (After asking about General Levi)
Off the Rails#440.dst: 抱歉啦，小子。還有別的要問的嗎？(問過 Levi 將軍之後)
Off the Rails#440.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#441.src: Uh... Anythin' else ta say? (After asking about Where were you during the murder)
Off the Rails#441.dst: 呃……還有別的要說的嗎？(問過「命案時你們在哪」之後)
Off the Rails#441.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#442.src: 's'all we got, though. Any other questions? (After asking about the Passengers)
Off the Rails#442.dst: 我們知道的就這些了。還有別的問題嗎？(問過乘客之後)
Off the Rails#442.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#443.src: Anyway, Got any questions that'll actually help ya with the case? (After asking about the Deraj)
Off the Rails#443.dst: 總之，有沒有真正能幫你辦案的問題？(問過 Deraj 之後)
Off the Rails#443.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#444.src: ...anythin' else to say before ya get back to it? (After asking to make an accusation)
Off the Rails#444.dst: ……回去查之前還有別的要說的嗎？(提出指控之後)
Off the Rails#444.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#445.src: Well, it was supposed to be a secret, until this dope let it slip. I s'pose we can just say it now, though.
Off the Rails#445.dst: 嗯，這本來該是機密，直到這個呆子說溜嘴。不過我想現在也可以直接說了。
Off the Rails#445.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#446.src: We were travellin' to {p}, to investigate some sort of incident.
Off the Rails#446.dst: 我們正要去 {p}，調查某種事件。
Off the Rails#446.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#447.src: Apparently, someone got in and killed all the soldiers, plus Commander Lilles... Serious stuff.
Off the Rails#447.dst: 據說有人闖進去把所有士兵都殺了，還包括 Lilles 指揮官……很嚴重的事。
Off the Rails#447.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#448.src: She was called there because a lot of the people killed were Constables. That, and Sovereign Zhiraok was apparently desperate for some extra hands.
Off the Rails#448.dst: 她被召去是因為死掉的人裡有很多是警備部隊的。再加上，Zhiraok 統領據說急著找人幫忙。
Off the Rails#448.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#449.src: Must be bad, if even he needs to ask for some help...
Off the Rails#449.dst: 如果連他都得開口求援，那一定很糟……
Off the Rails#449.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#450.src: Tch, you think we studied this stuff? We don't know much about her.
Off the Rails#450.dst: 嘖，你以為我們研究過這些？我們對她所知不多。
Off the Rails#450.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#451.src: Yeah, all we knew was that she was our highest-ranking leader, aside from the Marshal, Majin.
Off the Rails#451.dst: 對啊，我們只知道她是我們最高階的領導，除了元帥 Majin 之外。
Off the Rails#451.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#452.src: Well. Er. y'know, I got... tired. So I... took a nap.
Off the Rails#452.dst: 嗯。呃。就是，我……累了。所以我……小睡了一下。
Off the Rails#452.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#453.src: I TOLD you it would be a bad idea, Maury. There's a reason she brought two of us!
Off the Rails#453.dst: 我「就說」那是個爛主意，Maury。她帶我們兩個來是有原因的！
Off the Rails#453.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#454.src: Well- listen! Bein' made to come here in the morning right after workin' the night shift is a lot!
Off the Rails#454.dst: 喂——聽我說！上完夜班的隔天早上就被叫來這裡，那可不輕鬆！
Off the Rails#454.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#455.src: Also, we had a deal. You were supposed ta keep watch while I slept, idiot!
Off the Rails#455.dst: 而且我們說好了。我睡的時候你該負責看著，白痴！
Off the Rails#455.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#456.src: Yeah, well... I needed the bathroom, alright? What was I supposed to do, go right there in my armor?
Off the Rails#456.dst: 是啦，可是……我想上廁所啊，好嗎？不然我能怎樣，穿著盔甲當場解決嗎？
Off the Rails#456.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#457.src: Knowin' your smarts, I'm surprised ya didn't just do that anyway...
Off the Rails#457.dst: 以你的腦子，你居然沒真的那樣做，我還蠻意外的……
Off the Rails#457.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#458.src: ...You were the one worried about screwing it up! Just think how that would have looked, dude, we would have been so fired!
Off the Rails#458.dst: ……擔心搞砸的人是你欸！你想想那看起來會是什麼樣子，老兄，我們絕對會被開除！
Off the Rails#458.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#459.src: OBVIOUSLY, I'M NOT SAYING YOU SHOULD HAVE DONE THAT, HARVIN. By the Queen, you really tire me, sometimes...
Off the Rails#459.dst: 我「當然」不是說你應該那樣做，Harvin。女王在上，你有時候真的很累人……
Off the Rails#459.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#460.src: But... Ya know... Ya coulda made some effort to... hold it in..?
Off the Rails#460.dst: 不過……你知道嗎……你其實可以努力……忍一下的吧？
Off the Rails#460.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#461.src: You realize we're saying all of this in front of our detective, right..?
Off the Rails#461.dst: 你知道我們是在我們的偵探面前講這些的吧……？
Off the Rails#461.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#462.src: Whuh? Oh, yeah. You. Uh. Uhhh.
Off the Rails#462.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#464.src: We've not spoken to any of 'em, so we don't really know a whole lot.
Off the Rails#464.dst: 他們我們一個都沒說過話，所以真的不太清楚。
Off the Rails#464.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#465.src: I can vouch for the {p} guy. He was in the bathroom while I was waiting outside.
Off the Rails#465.dst: {p} 那個人我可以擔保。我在外面等的時候他在廁所裡。
Off the Rails#465.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#466.src: Took his sweet time in there, I tell you... Maybe I would've been able to protect the General if he had been quicker.
Off the Rails#466.dst: 他在裡面可真是慢條斯理，我跟你說……他要是快一點，說不定我還來得及保護將軍。
Off the Rails#466.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#467.src: I noticed that the one with the white shirt and red dress was weirdly quiet back when everyone was gathered around... I'm suspicious of 'em.
Off the Rails#467.dst: 我注意到那個穿白襯衫配紅裙的，剛剛大家圍過去的時候安靜得很奇怪……我懷疑他們。
Off the Rails#467.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#468.src: Pal, you must really be kiddin' me. Are ya really tellin' me you've lived in Fruma yer whole life, and haven't heard of Deraj?
Off the Rails#468.dst: 老兄，你不是在開玩笑吧。你真的要跟我說你在 Fruma 住了一輩子，卻沒聽過 Deraj？
Off the Rails#468.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#469.src: It's the big prison down in the aptly-named Penitence District to the south. Come on, everyone's heard of it...
Off the Rails#469.dst: 那是南邊 Penitence District 裡的那座大監獄，那名字取得還真貼切。拜託，誰沒聽過……
Off the Rails#469.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#470.src: Not many people know it like we do, though... Not that we know much at all about it either.
Off the Rails#470.dst: 不過知道得像我們這麼清楚的人不多……雖然我們其實也知道得不多。
Off the Rails#470.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#471.src: They say the prisoners there live an alright life, that they're just kept out of the way of Fruman society fer everyone else's sake...
Off the Rails#471.dst: 他們說那裡的囚犯過得還可以，只是為了大家好被隔離在 Fruma 社會之外……
Off the Rails#471.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#472.src: But, we've had several, er, acquaintances... who've ended up there. They never came back.
Off the Rails#472.dst: 可是我們有好幾個，呃，熟人……最後進了那裡。他們再也沒回來過。
Off the Rails#472.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#473.src: You NEVER want to go somewhere nobody ever comes back from. Never!
Off the Rails#473.dst: 你「絕對」不會想去一個沒有人回得來的地方。絕對不會！
Off the Rails#473.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#474.src: It's hard to know anything beyond that about it, in part because the guy in charge, Sovereign Oru, is never seen in public. Too busy with 'is duties, supposedly.
Off the Rails#474.dst: 除此之外就很難知道更多了，部分原因是管那裡的人、Oru 統領，從來不公開露面。據說是忙於職務。
Off the Rails#474.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#475.src: I hear he's a scary guy, so honestly, I'm glad...
Off the Rails#475.dst: 我聽說他是個可怕的傢伙，所以老實說，我還挺慶幸的……
Off the Rails#475.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#476.src: Kid, you've not even talked to everyone on the train yet. Come back when you've done that, then we'll talk.
Off the Rails#476.dst: 小子，車上的人你根本還沒全問過。等你問完了再回來，我們再談。
Off the Rails#476.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#477.src: 'Til then, we're not lettin' ya make an accusation. Anythin' else ta say? (Harvin and Maury's normal dialogue options reappear)
Off the Rails#477.dst: 在那之前，我們不會讓你提出指控。還有別的要說的嗎？(Harvin 和 Maury 的一般對話選項再次出現)
Off the Rails#477.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#478.src: Ah, yer ready then, are ya? Got someone in mind?
Off the Rails#478.dst: 啊，那你準備好了？心裡有人選了嗎？
Off the Rails#478.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#479.src: Thank the Queen... The train's gettin' quite close to {p} now, don't ya know?
Off the Rails#479.dst: 感謝女王……列車現在已經很接近 {p} 了，你知道吧？
Off the Rails#479.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#480.src: WHAT? Ugh. Well hurry up, then.
Off the Rails#480.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#481.src: Alright, I'll gather all the passengers for ya.
Off the Rails#481.dst: 好，我去把所有乘客集合過來。
Off the Rails#481.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#482.src: Then go away, kid. We have important things to do.
Off the Rails#482.dst: 那就走開吧，小子。我們有正事要辦。
Off the Rails#482.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#485.src: ...Oh, it's you again. Guards let you go, did they?
Off the Rails#485.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#486.src: ...Good for you, I guess. Me? I didn't think this trip could go worse, but somehow it did!
Off the Rails#486.dst: ……那恭喜你。我呢？我本來以為這趟旅程不可能更糟了，結果它居然更糟了！
Off the Rails#486.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#487.src: Now, there's a rogue murderer on the train! What if that general was only just the start??? It's like someone cursed me, I swear!
Off the Rails#487.dst: 現在車上有個逍遙法外的兇手！萬一那個將軍只是個開始呢？？？我發誓，簡直像有人詛咒我一樣！
Off the Rails#487.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#488.src: ...You're looking for the murderer, right? I guess I should help. It might end the trip on a marginally positive note if they're caught.
Off the Rails#488.dst: ……你在找兇手吧？我想我該幫忙。要是抓到了，這趟旅程至少能勉強有個好一點的結尾。
Off the Rails#488.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#490.src: ...Oh. It's you. The one from the murder scene.

Off the Rails#491.src: You want to talk? Sigh, fine. Fine, I guess.
Off the Rails#491.dst: 你想聊天？唉，好吧。好吧，隨便你。

Off the Rails#493.src: Ugh. Well, see, I'm from {p}. I... don't like it there. So I wanted to see what the {p} was like. It was bad.
Off the Rails#493.dst: 唉。這樣吧，我是 {p} 來的。我……不喜歡那裡。所以我想看看 {p} 是什麼樣子。結果很糟。
Off the Rails#493.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#494.src: And now, if the trip wasn't already horrible enough, someone's been murdered! Why can't anything be nice? Why can't anything good happen?
Off the Rails#494.dst: 而現在，這趟旅程好像還不夠慘一樣，居然有人被謀殺了！為什麼就不能有點好事？為什麼就不能發生點好事？
Off the Rails#494.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#495.src: What if the general was only the start??? We might all die!!!
Off the Rails#495.dst: 萬一那個將軍只是個開始呢？？？我們可能會全部死掉！！！
Off the Rails#495.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#496.src: ...You're looking for the murderer, right? I guess I should help. It might end the trip on a marginally positive note if they're caught.
Off the Rails#496.dst: ……你在找兇手吧？我想我該幫忙。要是抓到了，這趟旅程至少能勉強有個好一點的結尾。
Off the Rails#496.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#497.src: Alright... What do you need to know?
Off the Rails#497.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#498.src: What do you need to know? (After initial conversation)
Off the Rails#498.dst: 你想知道什麼？(初次對話之後)
Off the Rails#498.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#499.src: What? More questions? (Subsequent conversations with Flinn)
Off the Rails#499.dst: 幹嘛？還有問題？(後續與 Flinn 的對話)
Off the Rails#499.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#500.src: Any more questions? (When the dialogue options reappear)
Off the Rails#500.dst: 還有問題嗎？(對話選項再次出現時)
Off the Rails#500.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#501.src: No, I didn't see much at all. I've just been ignoring everything.
Off the Rails#501.dst: 沒有，我什麼都沒怎麼看到。我一直在無視周遭一切。
Off the Rails#501.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#502.src: The one thing I can recount is that the attendant came by and asked me if everything was to my liking. I ignored him.
Off the Rails#502.dst: 我唯一講得出來的是，那名車勤員經過並問我一切是否合我的意。我沒理他。
Off the Rails#502.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#503.src: I've just been sat right here for pretty much the entire ride. Just thinking.
Off the Rails#503.dst: 這一路我幾乎都坐在這裡。就只是在想事情。
Off the Rails#503.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#504.src: ...Gosh, sorry. I know I said I'd help with the case, but, thinking on it, I've not actually seen much that could help you. huh.
Off the Rails#504.dst: ……天啊，抱歉。我知道我說過會幫忙辦案，但仔細想想，我其實沒看到什麼能幫上你的。呵。
Off the Rails#504.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#505.dst: 什、什麼？一把鑰匙？在我後面？
Off the Rails#505.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#506.src: ...I SWEAR I did not put that there... Please, believe me...
Off the Rails#506.dst: ……我「發誓」我沒有把它放在那裡……拜託，相信我……
Off the Rails#506.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#507.src: Maybe the attendant..? No... He didn't stick around...
Off the Rails#507.dst: 難道是那個車勤員……？不對……他沒有停留……
Off the Rails#507.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#508.src: Oh, nice to see you again...
Off the Rails#508.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#509.src: I'm... I'm still in shock about what happened. And, frankly, afraid. There's a murderer in our midst! And I'm stuck in this train!
Off the Rails#509.dst: 我……我還在為剛才的事震驚。而且老實說，我很怕。我們之中有一個兇手！而我還被困在這列車上！
Off the Rails#509.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#510.src: What if they... what if they...
Off the Rails#510.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#511.src: ...It wasn't you, was it..? No... No, a guilty person wouldn't react the way you did. I trust you.
Off the Rails#511.dst: ……不是你吧……？不對……不，有罪的人不會有你那種反應。我信任你。
Off the Rails#511.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#512.src: It wasn't right of those guards to throw the blame on you like that... I'll tell you anything you need to know to figure out who really did it...
Off the Rails#512.dst: 那些衛兵那樣把責任推到你身上是不對的……你需要知道什麼，我都會告訴你，好查出真正的兇手……
Off the Rails#512.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#513.src: ...For the General's sake, and for ours.
Off the Rails#513.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#514.src: Ah, you... The one from the crime scene, yes?
Off the Rails#514.dst: 啊，你……命案現場那個人，對吧？

Off the Rails#515.src: I'm... I'm Demma. I'm a student from the Aelumia University.
Off the Rails#515.dst: 我……我叫 Demma。我是 Aelumia 大學的學生。
Off the Rails#515.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#516.src: I'm travelling to Auburn for my study project... I was excited, but with all that's happened, it's a little hard to keep that optimism...
Off the Rails#516.dst: 我要去 Auburn 做研究專題……本來很興奮的，可是發生了這一切，實在有點難維持那份樂觀……
Off the Rails#516.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#517.src: ...You're not the murderer, are you..? No, I don't think you are... Your reaction to their accusation was too... innocent, yes...
Off the Rails#517.dst: ……你不是兇手吧……？不，我不覺得是你……你聽到他們指控時的反應太……無辜了，是的……
Off the Rails#517.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#518.src: What those guards did to you back there... It wasn't right. I'll tell you anything you need to know to find the real culprit.
Off the Rails#518.dst: 那些衛兵剛才對你做的事……那是不對的。你需要知道什麼來找出真兇，我都會告訴你。
Off the Rails#518.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#519.src: So, let's get right to that, shall we?
Off the Rails#519.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#520.src: So, let's get to the questionining, shall we? (After initial conversation)
Off the Rails#520.dst: 那我們就開始問吧？(初次對話之後)
Off the Rails#520.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#521.src: Got more questions? (Subsequent conversations with Demma)
Off the Rails#521.dst: 還有問題嗎？(後續與 Demma 的對話)
Off the Rails#521.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#522.src: ...That should be everything. I'm sorry I didn't catch all the details. Any more questions? (After asking about what Demma saw before the murder)
Off the Rails#522.dst: ……應該就這些了。抱歉我沒能記住所有細節。還有問題嗎？(問過 Demma 在命案前看到什麼之後)
Off the Rails#522.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#524.src: ...Would you like to talk about anything else? (After asking about Helping with the bag)
Off the Rails#524.dst: ……還有別的想聊的嗎？(問過幫忙整理行李之後)
Off the Rails#524.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#525.src: ...Let's just... Move on to another subject. (After asking about the Book)
Off the Rails#525.dst: ……我們還是……換個話題吧。(問過那本書之後)
Off the Rails#525.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#526.src: Not much, but I can recount some events. The man in the canteen carriage came through here and took a while to come back. Not sure why, though I think it's likely he in the bathroom at the back of the train.
Off the Rails#526.dst: 不多，不過我能回想起一些事。餐車那位先生從這裡經過，過了好一陣子才回來。我不確定原因，不過我想他大概是在車尾的廁所。
Off the Rails#526.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#527.src: Shortly after, I wanted to get my notebook from my storage to write some thoughts I was having in regards to my research. On the way, I didn't pay attention to where anyone was sat.
Off the Rails#527.dst: 沒多久，我想去我的行李那邊拿筆記本，把我對研究的一些想法記下來。路上我沒注意誰坐在哪裡。
Off the Rails#527.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#528.src: In the storage room, I encountered the attendant, Telati, who seemed to be walking from the back of the train to the front. He asked me if I needed anything, and moved by.
Off the Rails#528.dst: 在行李車廂裡，我遇到車勤員 Telati，他看起來是從車尾往車頭走。他問我需不需要什麼，然後就過去了。
Off the Rails#528.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#529.src: Then, as I was on the way back here, I encountered a man named Malic, who was walking towards the back of the train, and we had a chat. He's now sat over there, with Maddison.
Off the Rails#529.dst: 接著，我要走回這裡的時候，遇到一位叫 Malic 的先生，他正往車尾走，我們聊了一下。他現在跟 Maddison 坐在那邊。
Off the Rails#529.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#530.src: I didn't see where he ended up going, because it was none of my business, and I had no reason to suspect foul play.
Off the Rails#530.dst: 我沒看到他後來去了哪裡，因為那不關我的事，而且我也沒有理由懷疑有什麼不對勁。
Off the Rails#530.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#531.src: I got seated, and then the man from the canteen came back... And then...
Off the Rails#531.dst: 我坐了下來，然後餐車那位先生回來了……然後……
Off the Rails#531.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#532.src: ...Shortly after that, those two guards came in panicking, and brought us to the scene of the murder.
Off the Rails#532.dst: ……沒多久，那兩名衛兵驚慌地衝進來，把我們帶到了命案現場。
Off the Rails#532.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#533.src: Purple slime..? Hm. Interesting. I have an immediate thought, but you'd need to check yourself, just to make sure my hunch is right.
Off the Rails#533.dst: 紫色的黏液……？唔。有意思。我立刻有個想法，不過你得自己去確認一下，看看我的直覺對不對。
Off the Rails#533.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#534.src: Give me a second to go grab my luggage, I left the book in there...
Off the Rails#534.dst: 等我一下，我去拿我的行李，書放在裡面……
Off the Rails#534.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#535.src: ...Oh, geez... I wasn't expecting to have to unpack this much...
Off the Rails#535.dst: ……噢，天啊……我沒想到得拆出這麼多東西……
Off the Rails#535.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#536.src: It was so hard to get this all to fit in there to begin with...
Off the Rails#536.dst: 當初要把這些全塞進去就已經夠難了……
Off the Rails#536.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#537.src: Sorry, but... I've done you a favour, so I'll ask that you do me one in return.
Off the Rails#537.dst: 抱歉，不過……我幫了你一個忙，所以我要請你也幫我一個。
Off the Rails#537.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#538.src: Help me put my luggage back. Until you do, I'll not let you read that book. I think that's a fair deal.
Off the Rails#538.dst: 幫我把行李收回去。在那之前，我不會讓你看那本書。我覺得這樣很公平。
Off the Rails#538.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#539.src: So you're taking my deal, then?
Off the Rails#539.dst: 所以你答應我的條件囉？
Off the Rails#539.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#540.src: Okay... Until you do, you're not reading that book, sorry.
Off the Rails#540.dst: 好吧……在那之前，你不能看那本書，抱歉。
Off the Rails#540.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#541.src: Thank you. Let's get to work, then.
Off the Rails#541.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#542.src: Interesting, right? It's got info on all the snails in Fruma! Such fascinating creatures...
Off the Rails#542.dst: 很有意思吧？裡面有 Fruma 所有蝸牛的資料！多迷人的生物……
Off the Rails#542.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#543.src: You should read more about the Murex Mollusc than just the bit I showed you. There's so many interesting facts about them.
Off the Rails#543.dst: 你該多讀一點 Murex Mollusc 的部分，不要只看我指給你的那一小段。關於牠們有好多有趣的事實。
Off the Rails#543.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#544.src: I still find it incredible how they're the Gigastropod's closest relative, despite the sheer cliff between them.
Off the Rails#544.dst: 牠們和 Gigastropod 之間隔著一整面陡崖，卻是最近緣的親戚，我到現在都覺得不可思議。
Off the Rails#544.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#545.src: It makes you wonder- how did they get down there? Or up there? There's actually an interesting query about which came first, the Gigastropod or Murex Mollusc?
Off the Rails#545.dst: 這讓人不禁想——牠們是怎麼下去的？還是上來的？其實有個有趣的問題：是 Gigastropod 先出現，還是 Murex Mollusc？
Off the Rails#545.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#546.src: Personally, as someone knowledgeable about the subject, I believe that the Gigastropod would have came first. Why? Well...
Off the Rails#546.dst: 以一個懂這個主題的人來說，我個人認為 Gigastropod 應該是先出現的。為什麼呢？嗯……
Off the Rails#546.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#547.src: ...The Murex Mollusc's special adaptations would give the Gigastropod a great biological advantage, obviously!
Off the Rails#547.dst: ……Murex Mollusc 那些特殊的適應能力，顯然會給 Gigastropod 帶來巨大的生物優勢！
Off the Rails#547.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#548.src: Think, toxins strong enough to bring down even Wooly Rhinos, in the {p}, with all its bugs? It'd be so strong!
Off the Rails#548.dst: 你想想，強到連 Wooly Rhino 都能放倒的毒素，放在滿是蟲子的 {p}？那會有多強！
Off the Rails#548.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#549.src: But then, you know, there is also the argument that the Gigastropod's impenetrable shell would be useful to the Murex Mollusc, too...
Off the Rails#549.dst: 但話說回來，也有人主張 Gigastropod 那副刀槍不入的殼對 Murex Mollusc 也很有用……
Off the Rails#549.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#550.src: That's why modern researchers, like my professor and I, tend to believe that there used to be other megasnails that served as a missing link between the two.
Off the Rails#550.dst: 所以像我教授和我這樣的現代研究者，傾向相信過去曾有其他巨型蝸牛，作為兩者之間失落的環節。
Off the Rails#550.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#551.src: It's believed that they would have lived across the whole province, but went extinct in the {p} and {p}, leaving {~} groups to evolve apart.
Off the Rails#551.dst: 一般認為牠們曾遍布整個行省，但在 {p} 和 {p} 滅絕了，留下 {~} 個族群各自演化。
Off the Rails#551.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#552.src: It's sad, really... If only those snails still lived... A happier world we would have...
Off the Rails#552.dst: 說真的，這很令人難過……要是那些蝸牛還活著就好了……我們會擁有一個更快樂的世界……
Off the Rails#552.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#553.src: It's speculated that the similarly-large Banana Slug of the {p} may hold answers, but it's highly elusive, only living on the branches of massive trees, so...
Off the Rails#553.dst: 有人推測 {p} 那種同樣巨大的 Banana Slug 或許握有答案，但牠極為難尋，只住在巨樹的枝幹上，所以……
Off the Rails#553.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#554.src: ...we've little data on them to determine the truth. It's dangerous enough to enter the {p}, let alone climb those vast redwoods!
Off the Rails#554.dst: ……我們手上的資料太少，無法判斷真相。光是進入 {p} 就已經夠危險了，更別說爬上那些高聳的紅杉！
Off the Rails#554.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#555.src: I'd love to study the Banana Slug... It's a dream of mine, for sure. If only the {p} were not so deadly...
Off the Rails#555.dst: 我好想研究 Banana Slug……那絕對是我的夢想。要是 {p} 沒有那麼致命就好了……
Off the Rails#555.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#556.src: Did you know that the {p} has huge creatures speculated to be the missing link between bird and-
Off the Rails#556.dst: 你知道 {p} 有一些巨大的生物，被推測是鳥類與——之間失落的環節嗎——
Off the Rails#556.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#557.src: OH! Oh, I'm so sorry... I got carried away...
Off the Rails#557.dst: 噢！噢，真的很抱歉……我又講得太忘我了……
Off the Rails#557.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#558.src: It's just... So fun to share these facts with people... Sometimes, you just don't realize how little they actually care...
Off the Rails#558.dst: 只是……跟人分享這些知識實在太好玩了……有時候你就是不會發現，對方其實根本沒那麼在乎……
Off the Rails#558.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#559.src: * Left-Click to pick up or drop pieces
Off the Rails#559.dst: * 左鍵點擊以拿起或放下拼塊
Off the Rails#559.speaker: Controls

Off the Rails#560.src: Couldn't manage? Sigh. Alright. Well, I'm still not letting you read the book until you do.
Off the Rails#560.dst: 沒收好？唉。好吧。那我還是不會讓你看那本書，直到你收好為止。
Off the Rails#560.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#561.src: I'm not letting you read that until you've helped me with my luggage, sorry.
Off the Rails#561.dst: 在你幫我把行李收好之前，我不會讓你看那個，抱歉。
Off the Rails#561.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#562.src: Oh, thank you so much! It took me hours to pack this the first time, you know.
Off the Rails#562.dst: 噢，太感謝你了！你知道嗎，我第一次打包這些花了好幾個小時。
Off the Rails#562.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#563.src: You're free to read the book now. I'll show you the page I have in mind.
Off the Rails#563.dst: 你現在可以看那本書了。我把我想到的那一頁指給你看。
Off the Rails#563.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#564.src: Alright, here. Murex Molluscs. Take a read.
Off the Rails#564.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#565.src: Please, hurry and find that killer. For everyone's sake.
Off the Rails#565.dst: 拜託，快點找出那個兇手。為了大家好。
Off the Rails#565.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#566.src: Ah, they let ya go, huh? Nice, I'm glad they saw some reason.
Off the Rails#566.dst: 啊，他們放你走了？很好，我很高興他們還講點道理。
Off the Rails#566.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#567.src: Being from the Roughworks, I've seen more than enough corrupt antics from dastards like them. It's really tiring.
Off the Rails#567.dst: 身為 Roughworks 出身的人，我看過太多那種混帳的腐敗手段了。真的很累人。
Off the Rails#567.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#568.src: What a generally... horrible turn of events. Until that killer is caught, we might all be in danger. I'm nervous, to be honest.
Off the Rails#568.dst: 整件事真是……糟糕透頂。在兇手被抓到之前，我們可能都有危險。老實說我很緊張。
Off the Rails#568.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#569.src: I'm still looking forward to my vacation, but... it's definitely been soured by what's happened.
Off the Rails#569.dst: 我還是很期待我的假期，可是……這件事確實把它弄糟了。
Off the Rails#569.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#570.src: ...Whatever. You're here to take questions, right? To figure out the actual killer? Alright.
Off the Rails#570.dst: ……算了。你是來問問題的吧？要找出真正的兇手？好啊。
Off the Rails#570.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#571.src: Oh, hey, it's you... The person from the murder scene.
Off the Rails#571.dst: 噢，嘿，是你……命案現場那個人。

Off the Rails#572.src: The name's Malic, nice to meet you. I'm glad those guards saw some sense and let you go.
Off the Rails#572.dst: 我叫 Malic，幸會。很高興那些衛兵還算講理，把你放了。
Off the Rails#572.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#573.src: Being from the Roughworks, I've seen more than enough corrupt antics from dastards like them. It's really tiring.
Off the Rails#573.dst: 身為 Roughworks 出身的人，我看過太多那種混帳的腐敗手段了。真的很累人。
Off the Rails#573.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#574.src: It'll be nice to get a break from all that. I'm heading to Auburn for a vacation, see.
Off the Rails#574.dst: 能從那一切裡喘口氣也不錯。我這是要去 Auburn 度假。
Off the Rails#574.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#575.src: It's a pretty special thing. In the Roughworks, people never really get the opportunity to travel the Queen's Line. Too expensive for us, typically.
Off the Rails#575.dst: 那是很特別的事。在 Roughworks，人們幾乎沒有機會搭女王線。對我們來說通常太貴了。
Off the Rails#575.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#576.src: It's always been a drea of mine to see what other parts of Fruma are like, though, so I... well, I saved up for a long time.
Off the Rails#576.dst: 不過，看看 Fruma 其他地方長什麼樣子一直是我的夢想，所以我……嗯，存了很久的錢。
Off the Rails#576.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#577.src: It was all going pretty nicely until that murder took place. Now? I'm... a little shocked, a little nervous, but I'm gonna try to keep a positive outlook.
Off the Rails#577.dst: 在那場謀殺發生之前，一切都還蠻順利的。現在呢？我……有點震驚，有點緊張，不過我會試著保持樂觀。
Off the Rails#577.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#578.src: Right. They're making you play detective, right? So you'll want questions from me. Well, go ahead, then, I'll do my best to answer.
Off the Rails#578.dst: 對了。他們要你當偵探吧？那你會有問題要問我。來吧，我會盡力回答。
Off the Rails#578.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#579.src: Well, go on, then. (After initial conversation)
Off the Rails#579.dst: 來吧，問吧。(初次對話之後)
Off the Rails#579.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#580.src: Anything else you wanna ask about? (When the dialogue options reappear)
Off the Rails#580.dst: 還有什麼想問的嗎？(對話選項再次出現時)
Off the Rails#580.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#581.src: Got more questions? (Subsequent conversations with Malic)
Off the Rails#581.dst: 還有問題嗎？(後續與 Malic 的對話)
Off the Rails#581.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#582.src: I've seen a few people, but nothing necessarily suspicious. Let me recount.
Off the Rails#582.dst: 我看到幾個人，不過沒什麼特別可疑的。讓我從頭說起。
Off the Rails#582.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#583.src: To begin with, it's important to note that I was in the seating carriage- the one behind me right now, for much of that time.
Off the Rails#583.dst: 首先要說明的是，那段時間我大多待在座位車廂——就是我現在背後這一節。
Off the Rails#583.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#584.src: The first thing I saw was some posh-looking guy walking to the back, with a book in hand. Seems he was going to the bathroom, so I didn't bother him.
Off the Rails#584.dst: 我第一個看到的是一個看起來很氣派的人往車尾走，手上拿著一本書。看樣子是要去廁所，所以我沒打擾他。
Off the Rails#584.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#585.src: I then got up to go grab my puzzle magazine from the lockers, and, on the way, encountered the attendant, Telati, who I briefly talked to.
Off the Rails#585.dst: 接著我起身去置物櫃拿我的謎題雜誌，路上遇到車勤員 Telati，跟他聊了幾句。
Off the Rails#585.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#586.src: During this conversation, I also noticed you, sleeping in your seat. You were muttering something about a snotty businessman, I think. We chuckled about it.
Off the Rails#586.dst: 聊天的時候，我還注意到你在座位上睡覺。我記得你在嘟囔什麼傲慢的商人。我們還為此笑了一下。
Off the Rails#586.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#587.src: On the way out of the carriage, I noticed the purple guard taking a nap in one of the seats. Didn't pay attention to anything else going on in there.
Off the Rails#587.dst: 走出那節車廂的時候，我注意到那名紫衣衛兵在其中一個座位上打盹。裡面其他事我就沒留意了。
Off the Rails#587.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#588.src: When I entered the storage carriage, I encountered Demma, who was walking towards the front, and we talked for a little while. It was nice getting to chat with someone.
Off the Rails#588.dst: 我進到行李車廂時，遇到 Demma，她正往車頭走，我們聊了一會兒。能跟人聊聊還蠻不錯的。
Off the Rails#588.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#589.src: As I was getting my newspaper, the posh guy passed by behind me, and then I bumped into Telati again as I was walking back to my seat.
Off the Rails#589.dst: 我在拿報紙的時候，那位氣派的先生從我背後經過，然後我走回座位的路上又撞見 Telati 一次。
Off the Rails#589.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#590.src: Then, just when I thought I had a chance to relax and solve some crosswords, the guards came barging in asking everyone to gather around. And now you're filled in.
Off the Rails#590.dst: 接著，就在我以為終於可以放鬆解幾題填字的時候，那些衛兵衝進來要大家集合過去。然後你就知道了。
Off the Rails#590.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#591.src: Ah, her. So, I was headed back to my seat after we all gathered around the scene of the murder, right? And then I notice Maddison, looking quite distressed.
Off the Rails#591.dst: 啊，她啊。是這樣的，我們大家在命案現場圍過去之後，我正要回座位，然後我注意到 Maddison 看起來很不安。
Off the Rails#591.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#592.src: I thought it might do her some good to have some company. So I went over and we spoke for a little while, and now we're just hanging out for the rest of the ride.
Off the Rails#592.dst: 我想有人陪陪她也許會好一點。所以我過去跟她聊了一會兒，現在我們就在這裡待完剩下的路程。
Off the Rails#592.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#593.src: ...You know, typically... when people from the higher regions come visit the Roughworks... they're rude. They treat us like filth. But...
Off the Rails#593.dst: ……你知道嗎，通常……上面幾個地區的人來 Roughworks 的時候……他們很無禮。他們把我們當垃圾看。可是……
Off the Rails#593.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#594.src: Maddison? She's been nothing but respectful and kind, even if it meant... viewing some things in a questionable manner. She's cool.
Off the Rails#594.dst: Maddison？她從頭到尾都很有禮貌、很善良，就算那意味著……要用一種值得商榷的角度看某些事。她很好。
Off the Rails#594.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#595.src: You're welcome! As I said, 'round where I'm from, those guys are a constant problem. ALWAYS being jerks to people.
Off the Rails#595.dst: 不客氣！我說過了，在我家鄉那邊，那些人是個長年的問題。「總是」在欺負人。
Off the Rails#595.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#596.src: Most of us have come to deeply dislike them. A lot of them are just local troublemakers who joined the Guard for a position of power over everyone else.
Off the Rails#596.dst: 我們大多數人都對他們深惡痛絕。他們很多本來就是地方上的麻煩人物，加入衛隊只是為了取得凌駕所有人的權力。
Off the Rails#596.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#597.src: ...Maybe I shouldn't be expressing these kinds of thoughts to you, knowing that you're looking for the person who murdered their division leader.
Off the Rails#597.dst: ……也許我不該對你講這些，畢竟你正在找殺害他們部隊領導的人。
Off the Rails#597.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#598.src: Eh. I'd rather tell a dangerous truth than lie to get out of potential trouble.
Off the Rails#598.dst: 唉。比起說謊來避開可能的麻煩，我寧可講一個危險的真話。
Off the Rails#598.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#599.src: Oh, hey... It's you! Ha... ha...
Off the Rails#599.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#600.src: Uhm... To be perfectly honest with you, I'm a little... rattled about what we just saw.
Off the Rails#600.dst: 呃……老實跟你說，我對我們剛才看到的事……有點嚇到。
Off the Rails#600.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#601.src: I'm really nervous... What if the murderer isn't done? What if they're a cursed one?
Off the Rails#601.dst: 我真的很緊張……萬一那個兇手還沒結束呢？萬一他是個受詛者呢？
Off the Rails#601.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#602.src: I wouldn't worry. Given the covert nature of their previous kill, they wouldn't do it in a room with four people. Besides, the train's not too far off now.
Off the Rails#602.dst: 我不會太擔心。從他們上一次下手那麼隱密來看，他們不會在一個有四個人的房間裡動手。何況列車現在也不遠了。
Off the Rails#602.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#604.src: If you wanna alleviate your worries completely, I'd suggest helping our friend here with the investigation. Tell 'em whatever they need to know.
Off the Rails#604.dst: 如果你想徹底放下擔憂，我建議你幫我們這位朋友調查。他需要知道什麼你就告訴他。
Off the Rails#604.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#605.src: Oh, yeah. You are doing that, aren't you? Right. Okay.
Off the Rails#605.dst: 噢，對耶。你在做那件事，對吧？好。好的。
Off the Rails#605.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#607.src: ...Sorry. I'm a little... rattled, after what's gone down...
Off the Rails#607.dst: ……抱歉。發生了那種事，我有點……嚇到……
Off the Rails#607.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#608.src: ...Those guards were wrong, right? It wasn't you?
Off the Rails#608.dst: ……那些衛兵搞錯了吧？不是你吧？
Off the Rails#608.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#609.src: Oh, calm down, Maddie. I've talked to them; they definitely wouldn't kill someone. Besides... I don't think they'd hurt you with people around, even if it were them.'
Off the Rails#609.dst: 噢，冷靜點，Maddie。我跟他們聊過；他們絕對不會殺人。何況……就算真是他們，我也不覺得他們會在有人在場的時候傷害你。
Off the Rails#609.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#610.src: ...Thanks, Malic... So, you. You're here to take questions, right? To figure out who did it?
Off the Rails#610.dst: ……謝謝你，Malic……那麼，你。你是來問問題的吧？要查出是誰做的？
Off the Rails#610.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#611.src: ...Oh, I hope it'll be okay... I'll help you however I can. Levi's killer needs to be found...
Off the Rails#611.dst: ……噢，希望不會有事……我會盡我所能幫你。一定要找出殺 Levi 的人……
Off the Rails#611.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#612.src: It could be any one of us! What if they're not done? What if they're a cursed one??? Oh...
Off the Rails#612.dst: 可能是我們任何一個人！萬一他們還沒結束呢？萬一他們是受詛者呢？？？噢……
Off the Rails#612.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#613.src: ...I suppose I should introduce myself. I'm Maddison, a tourist from {p}.
Off the Rails#613.dst: ……我想我該自我介紹一下。我叫 Maddison，是從 {p} 來的觀光客。
Off the Rails#613.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#614.src: I'm travelling the province using the Queen's Line, and was about to reach my final stop, {p}, before this disaster happened.
Off the Rails#614.dst: 我正搭著女王線環遊行省，本來就要抵達最後一站 {p} 了，結果就出了這場災難。
Off the Rails#614.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#615.src: Uhm... Ask me any further questions you need, I guess.
Off the Rails#615.dst: 呃……你還需要問什麼就問吧。
Off the Rails#615.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#616.src: Well, ask away, then. (After initial conversation)
Off the Rails#616.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#617.src: Got more questions? (Subsequent conversations with Maddison)
Off the Rails#617.dst: 還有問題嗎？(後續與 Maddison 的對話)
Off the Rails#617.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#618.src: That's all I remember, sorry. (After asking about what Maddison saw before the murder)
Off the Rails#618.dst: 我記得的就這些，抱歉。(問過 Maddison 在命案前看到什麼之後)
Off the Rails#618.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#619.src: Anything else you'd like to discuss? (After asking about Malic)
Off the Rails#619.dst: 還有別的想討論的嗎？(問過 Malic 之後)
Off the Rails#619.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#620.src: Anything else to talk about? (After asking about General Levi or the Crossword)
Off the Rails#620.dst: 還有別的想聊的嗎？(問過 Levi 將軍或填字遊戲之後)
Off the Rails#620.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#621.src: I've been in this carriage for almost the entire time, so I haven't seen too much. I've just been... staring out the window.
Off the Rails#621.dst: 我幾乎一直待在這節車廂，所以沒看到太多。我就只是……看著窗外。
Off the Rails#621.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#622.src: That's not to say that I saw nothing at all, though. Here's my recollection of the events:
Off the Rails#622.dst: 不過也不是完全什麼都沒看到。以下是我對事情經過的回想：
Off the Rails#622.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#623.src: The first thing I remember is that the guy from the canteen passed by on his way towards the back of the train... Not sure where he went.
Off the Rails#623.dst: 我記得的第一件事是，餐車那個人從這裡經過往車尾走……我不確定他去了哪裡。
Off the Rails#623.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#624.src: Then, Demma got up and walked away in the same direction.
Off the Rails#624.dst: 然後，Demma 起身往同一個方向走了。
Off the Rails#624.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#625.src: The attendant, Telati, arrived shortly after, to ask if everything was alright, and then made his way towards the back again.
Off the Rails#625.dst: 沒多久，車勤員 Telati 過來問一切是否還好，然後又往車尾走了。
Off the Rails#625.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#626.src: Soon after that, Demma came back, and the guy from the canteen soon followed.
Off the Rails#626.dst: 再過一會兒，Demma 回來了，餐車那個人隨後也回來了。
Off the Rails#626.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#627.src: Malic's so nice... You know, back when I visited the {p}, I found the citizens to be... intimidating, unkind. But Malic? He's different.
Off the Rails#627.dst: Malic 人真好……你知道嗎，我去 {p} 的時候，覺得那裡的居民……很嚇人、不友善。可是 Malic？他不一樣。
Off the Rails#627.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#628.src: ...To be honest, I was feeling a little... negative, about the way things were over there. But... I think Malic has given me a new perspective.
Off the Rails#628.dst: ……老實說，我對那邊的情況本來有點……負面的感覺。可是……我覺得 Malic 給了我一個新的角度。
Off the Rails#628.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#629.src: I'm glad to have met him.
Off the Rails#629.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#630.src: Uhm... I did know her, a bit. Not personally, but I was familiar with her as a person, you know..?
Off the Rails#630.dst: 呃……我算是認識她一點。不是私交，但我對她這個人還算熟悉，你懂嗎……？
Off the Rails#630.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#631.src: Back home in {p}, they do military parades all the time. I saw her there a lot.
Off the Rails#631.dst: 在 {p} 老家，他們常常辦閱兵。我在那裡看過她很多次。
Off the Rails#631.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#632.src: She was the leader of the Constables Division, and, and...
Off the Rails#632.dst: 她是警備部隊的領導者，然後，然後……
Off the Rails#632.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#634.src: MALIC! I think I... No... Uhmmm...
Off the Rails#634.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#635.src: Ah, the crossword? You got one, finally?
Off the Rails#635.dst: 啊，填字遊戲？你終於解出一題了？
Off the Rails#635.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#636.src: I... I don't know! I don't know!!!
Off the Rails#636.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#637.src: Maddie here was telling me of her visit to the Roughworks, and her thoughts on our culture, so I thought I'd give her a quiz, see.
Off the Rails#637.dst: Maddie 剛才在跟我講她去 Roughworks 的事，還有她對我們文化的看法，所以我想出個題目考考她。
Off the Rails#637.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#638.src: It's a crossword from my favourite magazine, Puzzle Factory. Thought it might, y'know, help take her mind off things.
Off the Rails#638.dst: 這是我最愛的雜誌《謎題工廠》裡的填字遊戲。我想這也許能，你知道的，讓她轉移一下注意力。
Off the Rails#638.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#640.src: HEY!!! Well... if it's so easy, SOLVE IT!
Off the Rails#640.dst: 喂！！！那……那既然這麼簡單，你來解啊！
Off the Rails#640.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#641.src: You know, I was going to say something else, but now I forgot!!!
Off the Rails#641.dst: 你知道嗎，我本來還要說別的，結果現在忘了！！！
Off the Rails#641.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#643.src: Maybe it'll clear your head if our friend here solves the crossword. Proves it's easy.
Off the Rails#643.dst: 也許讓我們這位朋友來解這題填字，你的頭腦就清楚了。順便證明它很簡單。
Off the Rails#643.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#645.src: Alright, fine! Go on! do the crossword!
Off the Rails#645.dst: 好，好吧！去啊！解那題填字！
Off the Rails#645.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#646.src: Ready to try the crossword? It's not easy!!!
Off the Rails#646.dst: 準備好試試那題填字了嗎？不簡單喔！！！
Off the Rails#646.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#648.src: SEE??? It's not easy, they're too intimidated to do it.
Off the Rails#648.dst: 看吧？？？它不簡單，他們被嚇得不敢解。
Off the Rails#648.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#649.dst: 哈哈哈哈哈……你會知道的……！
Off the Rails#649.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#650.src: * Click to select a column or row
Off the Rails#650.dst: * 點擊以選擇一欄或一列
Off the Rails#650.speaker: Controls

Off the Rails#652.src: As a subscriber to this paper, I'm honestly getting a little tired of the riddles that just talk about how great the province is... Some variation of this question's in like, every single issue.
Off the Rails#652.dst: 身為這份報紙的訂戶，老實說我對那些一天到晚在講這個行省有多棒的謎題有點膩了……幾乎每一期都有這種題目的變體。
Off the Rails#652.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#654.src: DAMNIT!!! That was so obvious! I had it, I swear!!!!!!
Off the Rails#654.dst: 該死！！！那也太明顯了！我本來就想到了，我發誓！！！！！！
Off the Rails#654.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#655.src: Wait, that wasn't allowed? I thought it was cool...
Off the Rails#655.dst: 等等，那樣不行嗎？我還以為那樣很酷……
Off the Rails#655.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#656.src: Hey! That's not how you spell his... oh, whatever, it doesn't actually matter.
Off the Rails#656.dst: 喂！他的名字不是那樣拼的……噢，算了，反正也不重要。
Off the Rails#656.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#657.src: I've always thought it's, uh, really stupid that they named those trees that. Maddison loves it though?
Off the Rails#657.dst: 我一直覺得他們把那些樹取那種名字，呃，蠢斃了。不過 Maddison 好像很愛？
Off the Rails#657.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#658.src: Yep, and then it takes even more to hold on to it!
Off the Rails#658.dst: 對，而且要抓住它還得花更多力氣！
Off the Rails#658.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#659.src: Oh, goodness, crossword... Don't make me think of that again...
Off the Rails#659.dst: 噢，天啊，填字遊戲……別讓我再想起那個了……
Off the Rails#659.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#660.src: Man... heard that didn't go super well this year...
Off the Rails#660.dst: 唉……聽說今年那場辦得不太順利……
Off the Rails#660.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#661.src: SEE??? They couldn't do it. It was too hard!
Off the Rails#661.dst: 看吧？？？他們解不出來。那太難了！
Off the Rails#661.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#662.src: Have you remembered what you were thinking about?
Off the Rails#662.dst: 你想起你剛才在想什麼了嗎？
Off the Rails#662.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#665.src: UGH, what????? Damnit! I guess I didn't pay good enough attention on my trip...
Off the Rails#665.dst: 唉，什麼？？？？？該死！看來我旅行的時候不夠用心……
Off the Rails#665.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#666.src: Honestly, don't worry. Given what you've told me about your own home, I can't imagine the Roughworks are really worth knowing about, for someone like you.
Off the Rails#666.dst: 老實說，別放在心上。從你跟我說的你家鄉的樣子來看，我想 Roughworks 對你這樣的人來說，實在也沒什麼好認識的。
Off the Rails#666.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#668.src: Oh, right! I just remembered what I was going to say.
Off the Rails#668.dst: 噢，對了！我想起我剛才要說什麼了。
Off the Rails#668.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#669.src: General Levi came from the {p}, specifically a noble house called House Takshah.
Off the Rails#669.dst: Levi 將軍是 {p} 出身的，具體來說是一個叫 Takshah 家的貴族家族。
Off the Rails#669.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#670.src: Apparently, some people have it out for that house in particular... That's all I know though, sorry.
Off the Rails#670.dst: 據說有些人特別跟那個家族過不去……不過我知道的就只有這些，抱歉。
Off the Rails#670.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#671.src: ...That blasted attendant... He better give me m-
Off the Rails#671.dst: ……那個該死的車勤員……他最好把我的——
Off the Rails#671.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#672.src: ...Ah, you! You again. They let you go, hm?
Off the Rails#672.dst: ……啊，是你！又是你。他們放你走了？
Off the Rails#672.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#673.src: Lucky. Those Constables... Majin has them stationed around {p} for our safety, but they're always causing trouble. I don't trust people like them.
Off the Rails#673.dst: 運氣不錯。那些警備隊……Majin 為了我們的安全把他們派駐在 {p} 一帶，可他們老是惹麻煩。我不信任那種人。
Off the Rails#673.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#674.src: Still, I suppose Levi would have been different, given her high role. How cruel it is that someone cut her life short...
Off the Rails#674.dst: 不過話說回來，Levi 想必不一樣，畢竟她地位這麼高。有人縮短了她的生命，何其殘忍……
Off the Rails#674.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#675.src: You are looking for the perpetrator, yes? I'll tell you anything you need to know.
Off the Rails#675.dst: 你在找兇手，是嗎？你需要知道什麼我都會告訴你。
Off the Rails#675.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#676.src: ...That blasted attendant... He better give me m-
Off the Rails#676.dst: ……那個該死的車勤員……他最好把我的——

Off the Rails#677.src: ...Oh, it's you. You from the murder scene. They let you go, hm?
Off the Rails#677.dst: ……噢，是你。命案現場那個人。他們放你走了？

Off the Rails#678.src: Lucky. Those Constables... Majin has them stationed around {p} for our safety, but they're always causing trouble. I don't trust people like them.
Off the Rails#678.dst: 運氣不錯。那些警備隊……Majin 為了我們的安全把他們派駐在 {p} 一帶，可他們老是惹麻煩。我不信任那種人。

Off the Rails#679.src: Still, I suppose Levi would have been different, given her high role. How cruel it is that someone cut her life short...
Off the Rails#679.dst: 不過話說回來，Levi 想必不一樣，畢竟她地位這麼高。有人縮短了她的生命，何其殘忍……

Off the Rails#680.src: You are looking for the perpetrator, yes? I'll tell you anything you need to know. I suppose the first thing would be an introduction.
Off the Rails#680.dst: 你在找兇手，是嗎？你需要知道什麼我都會告訴你。我想第一件事該是自我介紹。

Off the Rails#681.src: I am Cemor, of House Efelu, a noble house of small repute, though soon it shall surely rise.
Off the Rails#681.dst: 我是 Cemor，Efelu 家的人，一個聲望不高的貴族家族，不過想必很快就會崛起。
Off the Rails#681.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#682.src: I'm travelling from my home, the {p}, to Auburn. Why? Well, I booked a ticket to go to the Festival of the Queen, but... for the wrong date.
Off the Rails#682.dst: 我從我的家鄉 {p} 要去 Auburn。為什麼？嗯，我訂了去看女王慶典的票，但是……訂錯了日期。
Off the Rails#682.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#683.src: I didn't want that money to go to waste, so I'm going to go and visit {p} anyway. There's probably some festival left to experience.
Off the Rails#683.dst: 我不想讓那筆錢白花，所以還是決定去 {p} 一趟。想必還會剩下一些慶典可以體驗。
Off the Rails#683.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#684.src: But enough about little old me. You are here to ask questions. Go on.
Off the Rails#684.dst: 不過我這點小事就講到這裡。你是來問問題的。請吧。
Off the Rails#684.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#685.src: Go ahead, now. Ask away. (After initial conversation)
Off the Rails#685.dst: 來吧，問吧。(初次對話之後)
Off the Rails#685.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#686.src: What is it now? More questions? (Subsequent conversations with Cemor)
Off the Rails#686.dst: 這次又怎麼了？還有問題？(後續與 Cemor 的對話)
Off the Rails#686.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#687.src: What else have you to ask? (After asking about what Cemor saw before the murder)
Off the Rails#687.dst: 你還有什麼要問的？(問過 Cemor 在命案前看到什麼之後)
Off the Rails#687.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#688.src: But let us move on from that. Any more questions? (After asking about Constables)
Off the Rails#688.dst: 不過我們就此打住吧。還有問題嗎？(問過警備隊之後)
Off the Rails#688.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#689.src: Any more questions? (After asking about what Cemor is mad about)
Off the Rails#689.dst: 還有問題嗎？(問過 Cemor 在氣什麼之後)
Off the Rails#689.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#690.src: Anywho, thank you for the food. Now, ask me questions if you have any, leave me to my meal otherwise. (After giving Cemor his meal)
Off the Rails#690.dst: 總之，多謝你的餐點。那麼，有問題就問，沒有的話就讓我安靜用餐吧。(把餐點交給 Cemor 之後)
Off the Rails#690.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#691.src: I didn't see much at all, because I was in the bathroom for much of the time. There's only one thing I saw that could be of note.
Off the Rails#691.dst: 我幾乎什麼都沒看到，因為那段時間我大多在廁所裡。只有一件事值得一提。
Off the Rails#691.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#692.src: When I reached the back of the train, where the bathroom is located, I noticed the attendant, Telati.
Off the Rails#692.dst: 我走到列車尾端、也就是廁所所在的地方時，注意到車勤員 Telati。
Off the Rails#692.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#693.src: He was just stood around, up to... something. When he saw me enter, he seemed to panic and left the carriage. How suspicious.
Off the Rails#693.dst: 他就站在那裡，在……做些什麼。他看到我進來，似乎慌了一下，就離開了那節車廂。何其可疑。
Off the Rails#693.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#694.dst: 咳。警備隊。永遠是個麻煩。
Off the Rails#694.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#695.src: They're supposedly stronger than the regular divisional soldiers, but at least those divisional soldiers knew respect.
Off the Rails#695.dst: 他們據說比一般的地區部隊士兵強，但至少那些地區士兵懂得尊重。
Off the Rails#695.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#696.src: The Constables are often from other regions, so they're not part of the local community- they're less friendly. This makes them HORRIBLE town guards.
Off the Rails#696.dst: 警備隊常常是從別的地區調來的，所以不屬於當地社群——他們比較不友善。這讓他們成為「糟糕透頂」的城鎮衛兵。
Off the Rails#696.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#697.src: I speak from experience. Our Sovereign, Majin, replaced the {p} guard with Constables a few years ago. Supposedly to better protect us.
Off the Rails#697.dst: 我是有切身經驗的。我們的統領 Majin 幾年前把 {p} 的衛兵換成了警備隊。據說是為了更好地保護我們。
Off the Rails#697.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#698.src: Given his lack of improvements to the town besides that, I doubt that's the real reason. He just did it for the praise.
Off the Rails#698.dst: 考慮到他除此之外對城鎮毫無改善，我很懷疑那是真正的原因。他只是為了博取讚譽罷了。
Off the Rails#698.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#699.src: If he REALLY wanted to please us, he should have had some of those spangly Wings guard us. They don't do anything but stand around looking cool, anyway.
Off the Rails#699.dst: 他如果「真的」想討好我們，就該派幾個那種光鮮亮麗的羽翼部隊來守衛我們。反正他們除了站著擺帥什麼也不做。
Off the Rails#699.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#700.src: They're the best of the best, and I'm sure they would serve us better than those unruly Constables. They have the decorum not to scoff in our faces.
Off the Rails#700.dst: 他們是精英中的精英，我相信他們會比那些粗野的警備隊更好地為我們服務。他們至少有教養，不會當面嗤笑我們。
Off the Rails#700.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#701.src: Yes, that's right- scoff in our faces. That's how little respect these Constables have for the nobility. It's ridiculous.
Off the Rails#701.dst: 是的，你沒聽錯——當面嗤笑我們。這些警備隊對貴族的尊重就只有這麼一點。荒謬至極。
Off the Rails#701.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#702.src: A friend of mine, from House Krisa, was humiliated by a pair of rude Constables in {p} a while back. His handmade clothes were ruined! Covered in dye!
Off the Rails#702.dst: 我一位 Krisa 家的朋友，前陣子在 {p} 被兩個無禮的警備隊員羞辱。他手工訂製的衣服毀了！沾滿了染料！
Off the Rails#702.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#703.src: He had one of his friends in House Liftal contact Majin about it, so I'm sure those fools got what they deserved... Heh.
Off the Rails#703.dst: 他請了一位 Liftal 家的朋友去向 Majin 反映，所以我相信那兩個蠢貨得到了應有的下場……呵。
Off the Rails#703.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#704.src: ...Anyway. All of this to say: Constables are no good. I am not fond of them.
Off the Rails#704.dst: ……總之。說了這麼多就是要講：警備隊不是什麼好東西。我對他們沒有好感。
Off the Rails#704.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#705.src: Ugh. It's that attendant, Telati. I asked him for a meal hours ago, and he STILL hasn't even STARTED on it!
Off the Rails#705.dst: 唉。是那個車勤員 Telati。我幾個小時前就跟他點了餐，他到現在「連做都還沒開始」！
Off the Rails#705.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#706.src: ...Could you do me a favour go and ask him to get a move on? I'm tired of waiting here.
Off the Rails#706.dst: ……可以請你幫個忙，去叫他動作快一點嗎？我在這裡等膩了。
Off the Rails#706.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#707.src: You..? You made it? He reallu had you do it for him???
Off the Rails#707.dst: 你……？你做的？他真的叫你替他做？？？
Off the Rails#707.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#708.src: Goodness... I'm going to be leaving a poor review of this train in the paper, and telling my friends of this disappointment...
Off the Rails#708.dst: 天啊……我要在報上給這列車寫一則差評，還要告訴我的朋友們這件令人失望的事……
Off the Rails#708.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#709.src: ...Speaking of gossip, I thought of something I heard recently that might be useful to you...
Off the Rails#709.dst: ……說到八卦，我想起最近聽到的一件事，也許對你有用……
Off the Rails#709.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#710.src: Yes, I heard from some friends that General Levi was being called to {p} by Sovereign Zhiraok.
Off the Rails#710.dst: 是的，我從幾個朋友那裡聽說，Levi 將軍是被 Zhiraok 統領召去 {p} 的。
Off the Rails#710.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#711.src: Of course, I'm sure you already knew that. My point is this- word was out about what was happening, so I bet whoever killed her had this insider information.
Off the Rails#711.dst: 當然，我相信你早就知道了。我的重點是——這件事已經傳開了，所以我打賭殺她的人握有這個內部消息。
Off the Rails#711.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#712.src: Truly curious... Who might know about that?
Off the Rails#712.dst: 真是耐人尋味……有誰可能知道那件事呢？
Off the Rails#712.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#714.src: Make an accusation at [-{~}, {~}, {~}], or seek more evidence.

Off the Rails#716.src: Hm. I suppose it makes enough sense. They were awfully quiet when we found the body.
Off the Rails#716.dst: 唔。我想這說得通。我們發現屍體的時候，他們安靜得很不尋常。
Off the Rails#716.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#717.src: I dunno, Maury. Something doesn't seem right about this.
Off the Rails#717.dst: 我不知道欸，Maury。這件事總覺得哪裡不對。
Off the Rails#717.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#719.src: ...having seen what other parts of Fruma are like, maybe prison would be... an improvement...
Off the Rails#719.dst: ……看過 Fruma 其他地方是什麼樣子之後，也許坐牢反而是……一種改善……
Off the Rails#719.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#720.src: Works for us, I guess. Just uh, go along with what we tell 'em, alright?
Off the Rails#720.dst: 那對我們來說沒差。你就，呃，照我們跟他們講的說法配合一下，好嗎？
Off the Rails#720.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#721.src: Good timin', too. The train's about to arrive in {p}.
Off the Rails#721.dst: 時間也剛好。列車就要到 {p} 了。
Off the Rails#721.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#723.src: Yeah, I suppose a university student could get their hands on the weird substances that were involved here. I see it.
Off the Rails#723.dst: 對啊，我想一個大學生確實弄得到這件案子裡用到的那些怪東西。我看得出來。
Off the Rails#723.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#724.src: But- but why would I kill a general? I don't want to hurt anyone!
Off the Rails#724.dst: 可是——可是我為什麼要殺一位將軍？我不想傷害任何人！
Off the Rails#724.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#725.src: Yeah, Maury, I don't really see a motivation here...
Off the Rails#725.dst: 對啊 Maury，我實在看不出動機在哪……
Off the Rails#725.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#726.src: Hm... Well, whatever, we never were goin' off of actual guilt, anyway.
Off the Rails#726.dst: 唔……嗯，隨便啦，反正我們本來就不是照真正的罪責在辦。
Off the Rails#726.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#727.src: Yeah, true, I guess this works.
Off the Rails#727.dst: 對，也是，那我想這樣就行了。
Off the Rails#727.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#728.src: You're under arrest. We're about to arrive in {p}, and we'll be takin' ya straight to the local guard!
Off the Rails#728.dst: 你被捕了。我們就要到 {p} 了，我們會直接把你送去當地的衛隊！
Off the Rails#728.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#729.src: The {p} guy? That's who ya think did it?
Off the Rails#729.dst: {p} 那個人？你覺得是他做的？
Off the Rails#729.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#730.src: Yeah, what the heck? He was in the bathroom the whole time. This doesn't make sense...
Off the Rails#730.dst: 對啊，搞什麼？他全程都在廁所裡。這說不通吧……
Off the Rails#730.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#732.src: They are right...! It WAS I, Toxic Thistle of the Blossoming Blades, Fruma's deadliest vindicators!
Off the Rails#732.dst: 他們說對了……！那「就是」我，綻放之刃的劇毒薊，Fruma 最致命的復仇者！
Off the Rails#732.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#734.src: Behold, lapdogs, the beginning of our glorious revolution!
Off the Rails#734.dst: 看好了，走狗們，這是我們光榮革命的開端！
Off the Rails#734.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#735.src: Even in arrest, I have won... My brethren who stand against the Queen shall be mobilized by this glorious act of violence...
Off the Rails#735.dst: 即使被捕，我也贏了……我那些反抗女王的同胞，將因這光榮的暴力之舉而動員起來……
Off the Rails#735.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#736.src: The troubled people of Fruma shall wake to the fact that their rulers are not infallible gods; they shall at last understand that they alone bear the bridles of their own destiny...!
Off the Rails#736.dst: 受苦的 Fruma 人民將會醒悟：他們的統治者並非全知全能的神；他們終將明白，只有他們自己握著自身命運的韁繩……！
Off the Rails#736.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#738.src: And executed so poetically, too! Think- a titan of House Takshah, slain by merely the poison of House Efelu- even a small Murex Mollusc takes down the mighty rhinoce-
Off the Rails#738.dst: 而且執行得如此富有詩意！你想想——Takshah 家的一位巨人，僅僅死於 Efelu 家的毒藥——連一隻小小的 Murex Mollusc 都能放倒那壯碩的犀——
Off the Rails#738.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#739.src: Well, actually, Murex Molluscs are noted for being quite large for a sn-
Off the Rails#739.dst: 呃，其實，Murex Mollusc 以蝸牛而言算是相當大的——
Off the Rails#739.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#741.src: Before you take me away, you must admit... my exploits are impressive, no?
Off the Rails#741.dst: 在你們把我帶走之前，你們必須承認……我的作為令人印象深刻，不是嗎？
Off the Rails#741.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#742.src: Er... No. I ain't paid enough to care about whatever revolution thing ya were just talkin' about.
Off the Rails#742.dst: 呃……不。他們付我的薪水不夠讓我在乎你剛剛講的什麼革命。
Off the Rails#742.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#743.src: Yeah, do you really think any of this is gonna make a difference? Nobody cares about some general. None of this matters.
Off the Rails#743.dst: 對啊，你真的覺得這些會有什麼差別嗎？沒有人在乎什麼將軍。這一切都無關緊要。
Off the Rails#743.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#745.src: What does matter, though, is that you just made our job REAL easy fer us.
Off the Rails#745.dst: 不過真正有差的是，你剛剛讓我們的工作變得「超級」輕鬆。
Off the Rails#745.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#746.src: C'mon, punk, the train's arrivin' now. We're takin' you to the slammer.
Off the Rails#746.dst: 走吧，臭小子，列車到站了。我們送你去蹲苦窯。
Off the Rails#746.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#748.src: I guess a guy like him could grow jaded against the system. He's a Roughworker, after all.
Off the Rails#748.dst: 我想像他這樣的人是有可能對這套制度心生怨恨的。畢竟他是 Roughworks 出身的。
Off the Rails#748.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#749.src: Yeah, and he's the only guy who could possibly have unlocked the door to the private cabin, so it makes sense, really.
Off the Rails#749.dst: 對啊，而且只有他可能打得開私人包廂的門，所以這其實說得通。
Off the Rails#749.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#750.src: But... I would never kill one of the Queen's servants... Or anyone for that matter! Please! Have mercy!
Off the Rails#750.dst: 可是……我絕不會殺害女王的僕人……也不會殺任何人！拜託！饒了我吧！
Off the Rails#750.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#751.src: Heh. I don't think ya did it. But I don't care. We never were specifically lookin' to arrest the actual perpetrator.
Off the Rails#751.dst: 呵。我不覺得是你做的。但我不在乎。我們本來就不是特地要抓真兇。
Off the Rails#751.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#752.src: Yeah, you're believable enough. We'll go with you.
Off the Rails#752.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#753.src: Good timin', too! We're about to arrive in {p}.
Off the Rails#753.dst: 時間也剛好！我們就要到 {p} 了。
Off the Rails#753.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#756.src: Yeah, I uh, don' see the angle on this one, pal..
Off the Rails#756.dst: 對啊，我，呃，看不出這個角度欸，老兄……
Off the Rails#756.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#757.src: Eh, Roughworkers are pretty disobedient. I think it makes enough sense.
Off the Rails#757.dst: 呃，Roughworks 的人蠻不服管教的。我覺得這說得通。
Off the Rails#757.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#758.src: True... We never were arrestin' based on real guilt anyway, were we? We'll just go with this.
Off the Rails#758.dst: 也是……反正我們本來就不是照真正的罪責在抓人，對吧？那就這樣吧。
Off the Rails#758.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#760.src: Heh. Tell it to Oru, bub.
Off the Rails#760.dst: 呵。去跟 Oru 說吧，老兄。
Off the Rails#760.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#761.src: ...Is that something Oru does? Take questio-
Off the Rails#761.dst: ……Oru 會做那種事嗎？接受申訴——
Off the Rails#761.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#762.src: I DON'T KNOW, Harvin. It just sounded cool to say. And now you've ruined the moment.
Off the Rails#762.dst: 我「不知道」，Harvin。那只是聽起來很帥。現在你把氣氛毀了。
Off the Rails#762.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#763.src: ...Ech. Whatever. Train's about to arrive in {p}, let's get this guy to the slammer.
Off the Rails#763.dst: ……咳。算了。列車就要到 {p} 了，把這傢伙送去蹲苦窯吧。
Off the Rails#763.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#765.src: What? No! It couldn't have been her!
Off the Rails#765.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#766.src: Uh... Yeah, I don' see how it could've been her, bud.
Off the Rails#766.dst: 呃……對啊，我看不出怎麼可能是她，老兄。
Off the Rails#766.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#767.src: Do we care? We were going to arrest our detective here without evidence, anyway, Maury.
Off the Rails#767.dst: 我們在乎嗎？我們本來就打算沒有證據就抓我們這位偵探了，Maury。
Off the Rails#767.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#768.src: I guess yer right, though it might be hard to spin an Aelumian as guilty... They're pretty well-behaved.
Off the Rails#768.dst: 我想你說得對，不過要把一個 Aelumia 人說成有罪可能有點難……他們很守規矩的。
Off the Rails#768.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#769.src: ...This is ridiculous! You can't do this!
Off the Rails#769.dst: ……這太荒唐了！你們不能這樣做！
Off the Rails#769.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#770.src: Must I repeat myself? Do ya want to be put down as an accomplice? Quiet, you.
Off the Rails#770.dst: 我還要再說一次嗎？你想被列為共犯嗎？閉嘴。
Off the Rails#770.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#771.src: Hey, Maury... What if we arrested HIM instead. It'd be easier to explain, no?
Off the Rails#771.dst: 喂，Maury……不然我們抓「他」好了。那樣比較好解釋，不是嗎？
Off the Rails#771.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#773.src: ...you know what? Yes. Take me instead.
Off the Rails#773.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#775.src: Hands behind yer back, bub, the train's about to arrive in {p}.
Off the Rails#775.dst: 手放到背後，老兄，列車就要到 {p} 了。
Off the Rails#775.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#776.src: Come on, idiot. We're not going to let you accuse US, obviously.
Off the Rails#776.dst: 少來了，蠢貨。我們當然不會讓你指控「我們」。
Off the Rails#776.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#777.src: Even if it WAS me, there'd be nothing ya could do about it. We're the ones with power here. Now go and select one of the passengers, come on.
Off the Rails#777.dst: 就算「真的」是我，你也拿我沒辦法。這裡有權力的人是我們。現在去挑一個乘客，快點。
Off the Rails#777.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#778.src: ...You mean to suggest she... No, that's just not possible.
Off the Rails#778.dst: ……你的意思是說她……不，那根本不可能。
Off the Rails#778.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#779.src: Yeah, why would she? She had important business to do...
Off the Rails#779.dst: 對啊，她為什麼要？她有要緊的事要辦……
Off the Rails#779.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#780.src: Well, Harvin, maybe she got tired of her job? That Majin bossin' her around all the time's gotta get tirin'...
Off the Rails#780.dst: 嗯，Harvin，說不定她厭倦她的工作了？被那個 Majin 成天使喚一定很累人……
Off the Rails#780.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#782.src: You know what? Even if she did do it, I don't care; we need someone to blame. Now COME ON! Accuse someone already, preferably alive this time!
Off the Rails#782.dst: 你知道嗎？就算真是她做的，我也不在乎；我們需要有人背黑鍋。快點啦！趕快指控一個人，這次最好挑個活的！
Off the Rails#782.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#784.src: That guy we just arrested? He was STACKED! LOADED! We're gonna be vacationing in the {p} with this kind of money, haha!
Off the Rails#784.dst: 我們剛抓的那個人？他身上「超有錢」！「發財了」！有這種錢我們可以去 {p} 度假了，哈哈！
Off the Rails#784.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#785.src: Don't tell Maury, but I felt like you deserved a small cut of the profits, Y'know, for figuring it out, and all.
Off the Rails#785.dst: 別跟 Maury 說，不過我覺得你應該分一小份，你知道的，畢竟是你查出來的。
Off the Rails#785.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#786.src: HEY! HARVIN! Didn't I tell ya not to go and give 'em anything? Idiot!
Off the Rails#786.dst: 喂！Harvin！我不是叫你別給他們任何東西嗎？蠢貨！
Off the Rails#786.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#787.src: ...Shoot. Guess that's my cue to leave.
Off the Rails#787.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#788.src: Got a ticket or train pass?
Off the Rails#788.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#789.src: A General's trian pass??? But... But you're not
Off the Rails#789.dst: 一張將軍的列車通行證？？？可是……可是你不是
Off the Rails#789.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#790.src: Okay, okay... Sorry for questioning you, General. Where would you like to go today?
Off the Rails#790.dst: 好、好……抱歉質疑您，將軍。您今天想去哪裡？
Off the Rails#790.speaker: Ticket Collector
